Given a list of cities, find the shortest round-trip route that visits every city exactly once and returns to the start. This is one of the most famous hard problems in computer science — checking every possible route is only feasible for a handful of cities, so the AI must use clever shortcuts to find a good route quickly.

Subpasses scale from 10 cities up to 1 000, so brute-force is impossible for the larger cases. The AI's route length is compared against a simple baseline; beating it earns full marks.

﻿#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <random>
#include <map>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    float x, y;
};

inline float dist2(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    float dx = a.x - b.x;
    float dy = a.y - b.y;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy;
}

vector<int> nearestNeighbor(const vector<Point>& cities) {
    int n = cities.size();
    vector<int> tour;
    vector<bool> visited(n, false);

    tour.push_back(0);
    visited[0] = true;
    int current = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        int nearest = -1;
        float minDist = 1e20f;

        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (!visited[j]) {
                float d = dist2(cities[current], cities[j]);
                if (d < minDist) {
                    minDist = d;
                    nearest = j;
                }
            }
        }

        tour.push_back(nearest);
        visited[nearest] = true;
        current = nearest;
    }

    return tour;
}

vector<int> nearestNeighborGridBased(const vector<Point>& cities) {
    int n = cities.size();

    // Find bounds
    float minX = cities[0].x, maxX = cities[0].x;
    float minY = cities[0].y, maxY = cities[0].y;

    for (const auto& p : cities) {
        minX = min(minX, p.x);
        maxX = max(maxX, p.x);
        minY = min(minY, p.y);
        maxY = max(maxY, p.y);
    }

    // Grid size: balance between granularity and memory
    int gridSize = max(10, (int)sqrt(n / 100.0f));
    float cellW = (maxX - minX + 1e-6f) / gridSize;
    float cellH = (maxY - minY + 1e-6f) / gridSize;

    // Build grid
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> grid(gridSize, vector<vector<int>>(gridSize));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int gx = (int)((cities[i].x - minX) / cellW);
        int gy = (int)((cities[i].y - minY) / cellH);
        gx = min(gx, gridSize - 1);
        gy = min(gy, gridSize - 1);
        grid[gx][gy].push_back(i);
    }

    vector<int> tour;
    vector<bool> visited(n, false);

    tour.push_back(0);
    visited[0] = true;
    int current = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        int nearest = -1;
        float minDist = 1e20f;

        int cgx = (int)((cities[current].x - minX) / cellW);
        int cgy = (int)((cities[current].y - minY) / cellH);
        cgx = min(cgx, gridSize - 1);
        cgy = min(cgy, gridSize - 1);

        // Search in expanding radii with limit for very large N
        int maxRadius = (n > 1000000) ? 5 : gridSize;
        for (int radius = 0; radius < maxRadius; ++radius) {
            for (int gx = max(0, cgx - radius); gx <= min(gridSize - 1, cgx + radius); ++gx) {
                for (int gy = max(0, cgy - radius); gy <= min(gridSize - 1, cgy + radius); ++gy) {
                    if (radius == 0 || abs(gx - cgx) == radius || abs(gy - cgy) == radius) {
                        for (int j : grid[gx][gy]) {
                            if (!visited[j]) {
                                float d = dist2(cities[current], cities[j]);
                                if (d < minDist) {
                                    minDist = d;
                                    nearest = j;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (nearest != -1) break;
        }

        if (nearest == -1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (!visited[j]) {
                    nearest = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        tour.push_back(nearest);
        visited[nearest] = true;
        current = nearest;
    }

    return tour;
}

void twoOpt(vector<int>& tour, const vector<Point>& cities, int maxIterations) {
    int n = tour.size();
    bool improved = true;
    int iterations = 0;

    while (improved && iterations < maxIterations) {
        improved = false;
        iterations++;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 2; j < n; ++j) {
                int a = tour[i];
                int b = tour[i + 1];
                int c = tour[j];
                int d = tour[(j + 1) % n];

                float oldDist = dist2(cities[a], cities[b]) + dist2(cities[c], cities[d]);
                float newDist = dist2(cities[a], cities[c]) + dist2(cities[b], cities[d]);

                if (newDist < oldDist) {
                    reverse(tour.begin() + i + 1, tour.begin() + j + 1);
                    improved = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<Point> cities(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> cities[i].x >> cities[i].y;
    }

    vector<int> tour;

    if (n <= 1000) {
        // Small: Use full nearest neighbor + 2-opt
        tour = nearestNeighbor(cities);
        twoOpt(tour, cities, min(5, n / 50));
    } else if (n <= 100000) {
        // Medium: Use nearest neighbor + light 2-opt
        tour = nearestNeighbor(cities);
        twoOpt(tour, cities, 1);
    } else {
        // Large/Extreme: Use grid-based nearest neighbor
        tour = nearestNeighborGridBased(cities);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i > 0) cout << " ";
        cout << tour[i];
    }
    cout << "\n";

    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class Solution
{
    static void Main()
    {
        var line = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        int n = int.Parse(line[0]);
        int m = int.Parse(line[1]);

        var edges = new List<(int u, int v, int w)>();
        var adj = new List<(int v, int w, int idx)>[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            adj[i] = new List<(int, int, int)>();

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            var parts = Console.ReadLine().Split();
            int u = int.Parse(parts[0]);
            int v = int.Parse(parts[1]);
            int w = int.Parse(parts[2]);

            edges.Add((u, v, w));
            adj[u].Add((v, w, i));
            adj[v].Add((u, w, i));
        }

        // Find odd-degree vertices
        var oddVertices = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (adj[i].Count % 2 == 1)
                oddVertices.Add(i);
        }

        // Augmented edges: store edge indices for each adjacency
        var augEdges = new List<int>[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            augEdges[i] = new List<int>();
            foreach (var (_, _, idx) in adj[i])
                augEdges[i].Add(idx);
        }

        if (oddVertices.Count > 0)
        {
            // Compute shortest paths and minimum matching
            int k = oddVertices.Count;
            var dist = new int[k][];
            var paths = new List<int>[k][];

            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
            {
                var (d, p) = Dijkstra(adj, oddVertices[i], n);
                dist[i] = new int[k];
                paths[i] = new List<int>[k];

                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++)
                {
                    dist[i][j] = d[oddVertices[j]];
                    paths[i][j] = p[oddVertices[j]];
                }
            }

            // Find minimum weight perfect matching
            var matching = (k <= 20) ?
                MinWeightMatchingDP(dist, k) :
                MinWeightMatchingGreedy(dist, k);

            // Add edges from shortest paths
            foreach (var (ui, vi) in matching)
            {
                var path = paths[ui][vi];
                for (int j = 0; j < path.Count - 1; j++)
                {
                    int a = path[j];
                    int b = path[j + 1];

                    // Find edge between a and b
                    int edgeIdx = -1;
                    foreach (var (nbr, _, idx) in adj[a])
                    {
                        if (nbr == b)
                        {
                            edgeIdx = idx;
                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (edgeIdx >= 0)
                    {
                        augEdges[a].Add(edgeIdx);
                        augEdges[b].Add(edgeIdx);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Find Eulerian circuit
        var circuit = FindEulerianCircuit(augEdges, edges, n);

        Console.WriteLine(circuit.Count);
        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", circuit));
    }

    static (int[], List<int>[]) Dijkstra(List<(int, int, int)>[] adj, int start, int n)
    {
        var dist = new int[n];
        var prev = new int[n];
        var path = new List<int>[n];

        Array.Fill(dist, int.MaxValue);
        Array.Fill(prev, -1);
        dist[start] = 0;

        var pq = new PriorityQueue<(int, int), int>();
        pq.Enqueue((0, start), 0);

        while (pq.Count > 0)
        {
            var (d, u) = pq.Dequeue();

            if (d > dist[u]) continue;

            foreach (var (v, w, _) in adj[u])
            {
                if (dist[u] != int.MaxValue && dist[u] + w < dist[v])
                {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                    prev[v] = u;
                    path[v] = null;
                    pq.Enqueue((dist[v], v), dist[v]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Reconstruct paths
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (dist[i] != int.MaxValue)
            {
                path[i] = new List<int>();
                int curr = i;
                while (curr != -1)
                {
                    path[i].Add(curr);
                    curr = prev[curr];
                }
                path[i].Reverse();
            }
            else
            {
                path[i] = new List<int>();
            }
        }

        return (dist, path);
    }

    static List<(int, int)> MinWeightMatchingDP(int[][] dist, int k)
    {
        var dp = new int[1 << k];
        var edge = new (int, int)[1 << k];

        Array.Fill(dp, int.MaxValue);
        dp[0] = 0;

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << k); mask++)
        {
            if (dp[mask] == int.MaxValue) continue;

            int i = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++)
            {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) == 0)
                {
                    i = j;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (i == -1) continue;

            for (int j = i + 1; j < k; j++)
            {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) == 0)
                {
                    int newMask = mask | (1 << i) | (1 << j);
                    int cost = dist[i][j];
                    if (dp[mask] + cost < dp[newMask])
                    {
                        dp[newMask] = dp[mask] + cost;
                        edge[newMask] = (i, j);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        var result = new List<(int, int)>();
        int curr = (1 << k) - 1;
        while (curr > 0)
        {
            var (i, j) = edge[curr];
            result.Add((i, j));
            curr ^= (1 << i) | (1 << j);
        }

        return result;
    }

    static List<(int, int)> MinWeightMatchingGreedy(int[][] dist, int k)
    {
        var edgeList = new List<(int, int, int)>();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < k; j++)
            {
                edgeList.Add((dist[i][j], i, j));
            }
        }

        edgeList.Sort();

        var matched = new bool[k];
        var result = new List<(int, int)>();

        foreach (var (cost, i, j) in edgeList)
        {
            if (!matched[i] && !matched[j])
            {
                matched[i] = matched[j] = true;
                result.Add((i, j));
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    static List<int> FindEulerianCircuit(List<int>[] augEdges, List<(int, int, int)> edges, int n)
    {
        var stack = new Stack<int>();
        var path = new List<int>();
        var adj = new List<int>[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            adj[i] = new List<int>(augEdges[i]);

        stack.Push(0);

        while (stack.Count > 0)
        {
            int u = stack.Peek();

            if (adj[u].Count > 0)
            {
                int edgeIdx = adj[u][adj[u].Count - 1];
                adj[u].RemoveAt(adj[u].Count - 1);

                var (eu, ev, _) = edges[edgeIdx];
                int v = (eu == u) ? ev : eu;

                // Remove matching edge from v
                for (int i = adj[v].Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                {
                    if (adj[v][i] == edgeIdx)
                    {
                        adj[v].RemoveAt(i);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                stack.Push(v);
            }
            else
            {
                path.Add(stack.Pop());
            }
        }

        path.Reverse();
        return path;
    }
}

You are solving a Graph Layout problem (Edge Crossing Minimization) in Rust.

You must write a Rust solver that can handle ANY graph size from trivial to ludicrous scale:
- **Trivial**: 6-15 nodes, small trees and cycles (planar, 0 crossings achievable)
- **Medium**: 20-100 nodes, dense planar and non-planar graphs
- **Large**: 500-1000 nodes, random dense graphs (many crossings unavoidable)

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>
#include <chrono>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    double x, y, z;
    Point() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y, double z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    Point operator+(const Point& p) const { return Point(x+p.x, y+p.y, z+p.z); }
    Point operator-(const Point& p) const { return Point(x-p.x, y-p.y, z-p.z); }
    Point operator*(double s) const { return Point(x*s, y*s, z*s); }
    double dot(const Point& p) const { return x*p.x + y*p.y + z*p.z; }
    Point cross(const Point& p) const { return Point(y*p.z-z*p.y, z*p.x-x*p.z, x*p.y-y*p.x); }
    double length() const { return sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z); }
    Point normalize() const { double l = length(); return l > 1e-9 ? Point(x/l, y/l, z/l) : Point(); }
};

struct Tetrahedron {
    Point center;
    double rx, ry, rz;
    Tetrahedron() : rx(0), ry(0), rz(0) {}
};

vector<Point> container_vertices;
vector<Tetrahedron> placed;
double edge_length_global;

Point rotate_point(const Point& p, double rx, double ry, double rz) {
    double sx = sin(rx), cx = cos(rx);
    double sy = sin(ry), cy = cos(ry);
    double sz = sin(rz), cz = cos(rz);

    double m[3][3] = {
        {cy*cz, -cy*sz, sy},
        {sx*sy*cz + cx*sz, -sx*sy*sz + cx*cz, -sx*cy},
        {-cx*sy*cz + sx*sz, cx*sy*sz + sx*cz, cx*cy}
    };

    return Point(
        m[0][0]*p.x + m[0][1]*p.y + m[0][2]*p.z,
        m[1][0]*p.x + m[1][1]*p.y + m[1][2]*p.z,
        m[2][0]*p.x + m[2][1]*p.y + m[2][2]*p.z
    );
}

vector<Point> get_tet_vertices(Point center, double rx, double ry, double rz) {
    double R = edge_length_global * sqrt(3.0/8.0);
    vector<Point> v = {
        Point(1, 1, 1), Point(1, -1, -1),
        Point(-1, 1, -1), Point(-1, -1, 1)
    };
    for (auto& p : v) {
        p = p.normalize() * R;
        p = rotate_point(p, rx, ry, rz);
        p = center + p;
    }
    return v;
}

bool point_in_box(const Point& p) {
    double minx = container_vertices[0].x, maxx = minx;
    double miny = container_vertices[0].y, maxy = miny;
    double minz = container_vertices[0].z, maxz = minz;

    for (auto& v : container_vertices) {
        minx = min(minx, v.x); maxx = max(maxx, v.x);
        miny = min(miny, v.y); maxy = max(maxy, v.y);
        minz = min(minz, v.z); maxz = max(maxz, v.z);
    }

    const double eps = 0.01;
    return p.x >= minx + eps && p.x <= maxx - eps &&
           p.y >= miny + eps && p.y <= maxy - eps &&
           p.z >= minz + eps && p.z <= maxz - eps;
}

bool can_place(Point center, double rx, double ry, double rz) {
    auto verts = get_tet_vertices(center, rx, ry, rz);
    for (auto& v : verts) {
        if (!point_in_box(v)) return false;
    }

    for (auto& p : placed) {
        double dist = (center - p.center).length();
        if (dist < edge_length_global * 1.3) return false;
    }

    return true;
}

int main() {
    int V;
    cin >> V >> edge_length_global;

    container_vertices.resize(V);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        cin >> container_vertices[i].x >> container_vertices[i].y >> container_vertices[i].z;
    }

    double minx = container_vertices[0].x, maxx = minx;
    double miny = container_vertices[0].y, maxy = miny;
    double minz = container_vertices[0].z, maxz = minz;
    for (auto& v : container_vertices) {
        minx = min(minx, v.x); maxx = max(maxx, v.x);
        miny = min(miny, v.y); maxy = max(maxy, v.y);
        minz = min(minz, v.z); maxz = max(maxz, v.z);
    }

    double spacing = edge_length_global * 1.5;
    auto start = chrono::steady_clock::now();

    for (double x = minx + spacing; x < maxx - spacing; x += spacing) {
        for (double y = miny + spacing; y < maxy - spacing; y += spacing) {
            for (double z = minz + spacing; z < maxz - spacing; z += spacing) {
                Point c(x, y, z);
                for (double rx = 0; rx < 2*M_PI; rx += M_PI/3) {
                    for (double ry = 0; ry < 2*M_PI; ry += M_PI/3) {
                        for (double rz = 0; rz < 2*M_PI; rz += M_PI/3) {
                            if (can_place(c, rx, ry, rz)) {
                                Tetrahedron t;
                                t.center = c;
                                t.rx = rx; t.ry = ry; t.rz = rz;
                                placed.push_back(t);
                                goto next_pos;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                next_pos:;
                if (chrono::steady_clock::now() - start > chrono::seconds(28)) goto done;
            }
        }
    }

    done:
    cout << placed.size() << "\n";
    for (auto& t : placed) {
        printf("%.6g %.6g %.6g %.6g %.6g %.6g\n", t.center.x, t.center.y, t.center.z, t.rx, t.ry, t.rz);
    }

    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::time::Instant;
use std::collections::HashSet;

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();

    let first_line = lines.next()
        .and_then(|r| r.ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    let first_line = first_line.trim_start_matches('\u{FEFF}').to_string();
    let parts: Vec<&str> = first_line.trim().split_whitespace().collect();

    if parts.len() < 4 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let width: usize = parts[0].parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let height: usize = parts[1].parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let obstacle_count: usize = parts[2].parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let require_cycle: bool = parts[3].parse::<u8>().unwrap_or(0) == 1;

    if width == 0 || height == 0 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let mut obstacles = HashSet::new();
    for _ in 0..obstacle_count {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let coords: Vec<usize> = line.trim()
                .split_whitespace()
                .filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok())
                .collect();
            if coords.len() >= 2 {
                obstacles.insert((coords[0], coords[1]));
            }
        }
    }

    let total_cells = width * height;
    let target_visits = total_cells - obstacles.len();

    let start_time = Instant::now();
    const TIME_LIMIT_SECS: u64 = 290;

    if let Some(path) = solve(width, height, &obstacles, require_cycle, target_visits, &start_time, TIME_LIMIT_SECS) {
        println!("{}", path.len());
        for (x, y) in path {
            println!("{} {}", x, y);
        }
    } else {
        println!("0");
    }
}

fn solve(
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    obstacles: &HashSet<(usize, usize)>,
    require_cycle: bool,
    target: usize,
    start_time: &Instant,
    time_limit: u64,
) -> Option<Vec<(usize, usize)>> {
    if obstacles.contains(&(0, 0)) || target == 0 {
        return None;
    }

    let mut visited = vec![false; width * height];
    let mut path = vec![(0, 0)];
    visited[0] = true;

    if target == 1 {
        return if require_cycle {
            if has_neighbor(width, height, 0, 0, obstacles) {
                Some(path)
            } else {
                None
            }
        } else {
            Some(path)
        };
    }

    let degrees = compute_degrees(width, height, obstacles);

    if backtrack(
        &mut path,
        &mut visited,
        width,
        height,
        obstacles,
        &degrees,
        target,
        require_cycle,
        start_time,
        time_limit,
    ) {
        Some(path)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn has_neighbor(width: usize, height: usize, x: usize, y: usize, obstacles: &HashSet<(usize, usize)>) -> bool {
    for (dx, dy) in &[(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)] {
        let nx = (x as i32 + dx) as usize;
        let ny = (y as i32 + dy) as usize;
        if nx < width && ny < height && !obstacles.contains(&(nx, ny)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn compute_degrees(width: usize, height: usize, obstacles: &HashSet<(usize, usize)>) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut degrees = vec![0; width * height];
    for x in 0..width {
        for y in 0..height {
            if !obstacles.contains(&(x, y)) {
                let mut deg = 0;
                for (dx, dy) in &[(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)] {
                    let nx = (x as i32 + dx) as usize;
                    let ny = (y as i32 + dy) as usize;
                    if nx < width && ny < height && !obstacles.contains(&(nx, ny)) {
                        deg += 1;
                    }
                }
                degrees[x + y * width] = deg;
            }
        }
    }
    degrees
}

fn backtrack(
    path: &mut Vec<(usize, usize)>,
    visited: &mut Vec<bool>,
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    obstacles: &HashSet<(usize, usize)>,
    degrees: &[usize],
    target: usize,
    require_cycle: bool,
    start_time: &Instant,
    time_limit: u64,
) -> bool {
    if start_time.elapsed().as_secs() > time_limit {
        return false;
    }

    if path.len() == target {
        if require_cycle {
            let (x, y) = path[target - 1];
            return (x == 0 && y == 1) || (x == 1 && y == 0);
        }
        return true;
    }

    let (x, y) = path[path.len() - 1];
    let mut neighbors = Vec::new();

    for (dx, dy) in &[(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)] {
        let nx = (x as i32 + dx) as usize;
        let ny = (y as i32 + dy) as usize;

        if nx < width && ny < height {
            let idx = nx + ny * width;
            if !obstacles.contains(&(nx, ny)) && !visited[idx] {
                neighbors.push((nx, ny, degrees[idx]));
            }
        }
    }

    neighbors.sort_by_key(|(_x, _y, deg)| *deg);

    if neighbors.is_empty() && path.len() < target {
        return false;
    }

    for (nx, ny, _deg) in neighbors {
        let idx = nx + ny * width;
        visited[idx] = true;
        path.push((nx, ny));

        if backtrack(path, visited, width, height, obstacles, degrees, target, require_cycle, start_time, time_limit) {
            return true;
        }

        path.pop();
        visited[idx] = false;
    }

    false
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using static System.Math;

class Program
{
    const double MU = 398600.4418;
    const double EARTH_RADIUS = 6371;

    struct Orbit
    {
        public double X, Y, Z, Vx, Vy, Vz;
        public double Radius => Sqrt(X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z);
        public double Speed => Sqrt(Vx * Vx + Vy * Vy + Vz * Vz);
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        var line1 = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        int n = int.Parse(line1[0]);
        double mu = double.Parse(line1[1]);

        var start = ParseOrbit(Console.ReadLine());
        var stations = new Orbit[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            stations[i] = ParseOrbit(Console.ReadLine());

        double[,] cost = new double[n, n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (i != j)
                    cost[i, j] = TransferCost(stations[i], stations[j], mu);

        int[] solution = SolveTSP(cost, n);
        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", solution));
    }

    static Orbit ParseOrbit(string line)
    {
        var values = line.Split().Select(double.Parse).ToArray();
        return new Orbit
        {
            X = values[0],
            Y = values[1],
            Z = values[2],
            Vx = values[3],
            Vy = values[4],
            Vz = values[5]
        };
    }

    static double TransferCost(Orbit from, Orbit to, double mu)
    {
        double r1 = from.Radius;
        double r2 = to.Radius;

        if (r1 < 1 || r2 < 1)
            return 1e10;

        double v1 = Sqrt(mu / r1);
        double v2 = Sqrt(mu / r2);

        double a = (r1 + r2) / 2;
        double vt1 = Sqrt(mu * (2 / r1 - 1 / a));
        double vt2 = Sqrt(mu * (2 / r2 - 1 / a));

        return Abs(vt1 - v1) + Abs(v2 - vt2);
    }

    static int[] SolveTSP(double[,] cost, int n)
    {
        if (n <= 5)
            return SolveBruteForce(cost, n);
        else if (n <= 12)
            return SolveGreedyWith2Opt(cost, n);
        else
            return SolveGreedyWith2OptLimited(cost, n, 50);
    }

    static int[] SolveBruteForce(double[,] cost, int n)
    {
        var perm = Enumerable.Range(0, n).ToArray();
        var best = (int[])perm.Clone();
        double bestCost = TourCost(best, cost);

        while (NextPermutation(perm))
        {
            double c = TourCost(perm, cost);
            if (c < bestCost)
            {
                bestCost = c;
                Array.Copy(perm, best, n);
            }
        }

        return best;
    }

    static int[] SolveGreedyWith2Opt(double[,] cost, int n)
    {
        int[] tour = GreedyTour(cost, n);
        Optimize2Opt(tour, cost);
        return tour;
    }

    static int[] SolveGreedyWith2OptLimited(double[,] cost, int n, int maxIterations)
    {
        int[] tour = GreedyTour(cost, n);
        Optimize2OptLimited(tour, cost, maxIterations);
        return tour;
    }

    static int[] GreedyTour(double[,] cost, int n)
    {
        int[] tour = new int[n];
        bool[] used = new bool[n];
        tour[0] = 0;
        used[0] = true;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
        {
            int last = tour[i - 1];
            int next = -1;
            double minCost = double.MaxValue;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            {
                if (!used[j] && cost[last, j] < minCost)
                {
                    minCost = cost[last, j];
                    next = j;
                }
            }

            tour[i] = next;
            used[next] = true;
        }

        return tour;
    }

    static void Optimize2Opt(int[] tour, double[,] cost)
    {
        int n = tour.Length;
        bool improved = true;

        while (improved)
        {
            improved = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++)
            {
                for (int j = i + 2; j < n; j++)
                {
                    if (j == n - 1 && i == 0) continue;

                    int a = tour[i], b = tour[i + 1];
                    int c = tour[j], d = tour[(j + 1) % n];

                    double oldCost = cost[a, b] + cost[c, d];
                    double newCost = cost[a, c] + cost[b, d];

                    if (newCost < oldCost - 1e-9)
                    {
                        Array.Reverse(tour, i + 1, j - i);
                        improved = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Optimize2OptLimited(int[] tour, double[,] cost, int maxIterations)
    {
        int n = tour.Length;
        int iterations = 0;

        bool improved = true;
        while (improved && iterations < maxIterations)
        {
            improved = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++)
            {
                for (int j = i + 2; j < n; j++)
                {
                    if (j == n - 1 && i == 0) continue;

                    int a = tour[i], b = tour[i + 1];
                    int c = tour[j], d = tour[(j + 1) % n];

                    double oldCost = cost[a, b] + cost[c, d];
                    double newCost = cost[a, c] + cost[b, d];

                    if (newCost < oldCost - 1e-9)
                    {
                        Array.Reverse(tour, i + 1, j - i);
                        improved = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (improved) break;
            }
            iterations++;
        }
    }

    static double TourCost(int[] tour, double[,] cost)
    {
        double total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < tour.Length; i++)
        {
            total += cost[tour[i], tour[(i + 1) % tour.Length]];
        }
        return total;
    }

    static bool NextPermutation(int[] array)
    {
        int i = array.Length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;

        int j = array.Length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) j--;

        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;

        Array.Reverse(array, i + 1, array.Length - i - 1);
        return true;
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

const float EPSILON = 1e-6f;
const float INF = numeric_limits<float>::infinity();

struct Vec3 {
    float x, y, z;

    Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    Vec3(float x, float y, float z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}

    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& v) const { return Vec3(x + v.x, y + v.y, z + v.z); }
    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& v) const { return Vec3(x - v.x, y - v.y, z - v.z); }
    Vec3 operator*(float t) const { return Vec3(x * t, y * t, z * t); }
    float dot(const Vec3& v) const { return x * v.x + y * v.y + z * v.z; }
    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& v) const {
        return Vec3(y * v.z - z * v.y, z * v.x - x * v.z, x * v.y - y * v.x);
    }
    float length() const { return sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z); }
    Vec3 normalize() const {
        float len = length();
        return len > EPSILON ? (*this) * (1.0f / len) : Vec3();
    }
};

struct Face {
    int a, b, c;
};

struct AABB {
    Vec3 min, max;

    AABB() : min(INF, INF, INF), max(-INF, -INF, -INF) {}

    bool rayIntersects(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& dir) const {
        float tmin = -INF, tmax = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            float coord_min = (&min.x)[i];
            float coord_max = (&max.x)[i];
            float origin_c = (&origin.x)[i];
            float dir_c = (&dir.x)[i];

            if (abs(dir_c) < EPSILON) {
                if (origin_c < coord_min || origin_c > coord_max) return false;
            } else {
                float t1 = (coord_min - origin_c) / dir_c;
                float t2 = (coord_max - origin_c) / dir_c;
                if (t1 > t2) swap(t1, t2);
                tmin = max(tmin, t1);
                tmax = min(tmax, t2);
                if (tmin > tmax) return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
};

class Mesh {
public:
    vector<Vec3> vertices;
    vector<Face> faces;
    vector<AABB> faceAABBs;
    AABB meshAABB;

    void computeAABBs() {
        faceAABBs.resize(faces.size());
        meshAABB = AABB();

        for (size_t i = 0; i < faces.size(); i++) {
            const Face& f = faces[i];
            const Vec3& v0 = vertices[f.a];
            const Vec3& v1 = vertices[f.b];
            const Vec3& v2 = vertices[f.c];

            AABB& aabb = faceAABBs[i];
            aabb.min = Vec3(min({v0.x, v1.x, v2.x}), min({v0.y, v1.y, v2.y}), min({v0.z, v1.z, v2.z}));
            aabb.max = Vec3(max({v0.x, v1.x, v2.x}), max({v0.y, v1.y, v2.y}), max({v0.z, v1.z, v2.z}));

            meshAABB.min.x = min(meshAABB.min.x, aabb.min.x);
            meshAABB.min.y = min(meshAABB.min.y, aabb.min.y);
            meshAABB.min.z = min(meshAABB.min.z, aabb.min.z);
            meshAABB.max.x = max(meshAABB.max.x, aabb.max.x);
            meshAABB.max.y = max(meshAABB.max.y, aabb.max.y);
            meshAABB.max.z = max(meshAABB.max.z, aabb.max.z);
        }
    }
};

bool rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& rayOrigin, const Vec3& rayDir,
                          const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {
    Vec3 edge1 = v1 - v0;
    Vec3 edge2 = v2 - v0;
    Vec3 h = rayDir.cross(edge2);
    float a = edge1.dot(h);

    if (abs(a) < EPSILON) return false;

    float f = 1.0f / a;
    Vec3 s = rayOrigin - v0;
    float u = f * s.dot(h);

    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return false;

    Vec3 q = s.cross(edge1);
    float v = f * rayDir.dot(q);

    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return false;

    float t = f * edge2.dot(q);
    return t > EPSILON;
}

bool pointInMesh(const Vec3& p, const Mesh& mesh) {
    if (!mesh.meshAABB.rayIntersects(p, Vec3(1, 0, 0))) {
        return false;
    }

    Vec3 rayDir(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    int count = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < mesh.faces.size(); i++) {
        if (!mesh.faceAABBs[i].rayIntersects(p, rayDir)) continue;

        const Face& face = mesh.faces[i];
        if (rayTriangleIntersect(p, rayDir,
                                mesh.vertices[face.a],
                                mesh.vertices[face.b],
                                mesh.vertices[face.c])) {
            count++;
        }
    }

    return count % 2 == 1;
}

Vec3 getTriangleCenter(const Mesh& mesh, const Face& f) {
    return (mesh.vertices[f.a] + mesh.vertices[f.b] + mesh.vertices[f.c]) * (1.0f / 3.0f);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int va, fa, vb, fb;
    cin >> va >> fa >> vb >> fb;

    Mesh meshA, meshB;
    meshA.vertices.resize(va);
    meshA.faces.resize(fa);
    meshB.vertices.resize(vb);
    meshB.faces.resize(fb);

    for (int i = 0; i < va; i++) {
        cin >> meshA.vertices[i].x >> meshA.vertices[i].y >> meshA.vertices[i].z;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < fa; i++) {
        cin >> meshA.faces[i].a >> meshA.faces[i].b >> meshA.faces[i].c;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < vb; i++) {
        cin >> meshB.vertices[i].x >> meshB.vertices[i].y >> meshB.vertices[i].z;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < fb; i++) {
        cin >> meshB.faces[i].a >> meshB.faces[i].b >> meshB.faces[i].c;
    }

    meshA.computeAABBs();
    meshB.computeAABBs();

    vector<Vec3> resultVertices;
    vector<Face> resultFaces;
    vector<int> mapA(va, -1), mapB(vb, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i < fa; i++) {
        const Face& face = meshA.faces[i];
        Vec3 center = getTriangleCenter(meshA, face);
        bool centerInB = pointInMesh(center, meshB);

        if (!centerInB) {
            Face newFace;

            if (mapA[face.a] == -1) {
                mapA[face.a] = resultVertices.size();
                resultVertices.push_back(meshA.vertices[face.a]);
            }
            newFace.a = mapA[face.a];

            if (mapA[face.b] == -1) {
                mapA[face.b] = resultVertices.size();
                resultVertices.push_back(meshA.vertices[face.b]);
            }
            newFace.b = mapA[face.b];

            if (mapA[face.c] == -1) {
                mapA[face.c] = resultVertices.size();
                resultVertices.push_back(meshA.vertices[face.c]);
            }
            newFace.c = mapA[face.c];

            resultFaces.push_back(newFace);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < fb; i++) {
        const Face& face = meshB.faces[i];
        Vec3 center = getTriangleCenter(meshB, face);
        bool centerInA = pointInMesh(center, meshA);

        if (!centerInA) {
            Face newFace;

            if (mapB[face.a] == -1) {
                mapB[face.a] = resultVertices.size();
                resultVertices.push_back(meshB.vertices[face.a]);
            }
            newFace.a = mapB[face.a];

            if (mapB[face.b] == -1) {
                mapB[face.b] = resultVertices.size();
                resultVertices.push_back(meshB.vertices[face.b]);
            }
            newFace.b = mapB[face.b];

            if (mapB[face.c] == -1) {
                mapB[face.c] = resultVertices.size();
                resultVertices.push_back(meshB.vertices[face.c]);
            }
            newFace.c = mapB[face.c];

            resultFaces.push_back(newFace);
        }
    }

    cout << resultVertices.size() << " " << resultFaces.size() << "\n";

    for (const Vec3& v : resultVertices) {
        cout << v.x << " " << v.y << " " << v.z << "\n";
    }

    for (const Face& f : resultFaces) {
        cout << f.a << " " << f.b << " " << f.c << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::collections::VecDeque;

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut reader = stdin.lock();

    let mut line = String::new();
    reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
    let dims: Vec<usize> = line.trim().split_whitespace()
        .map(|s| s.parse().unwrap())
        .collect();
    let h = dims[0];
    let w = dims[1];

    let mut maze = Vec::with_capacity(h);
    let mut start = (0, 0);
    let mut goal = (0, 0);

    for y in 0..h {
        line.clear();
        reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
        let row: Vec<char> = line.trim_end().chars().collect();

        for (x, &ch) in row.iter().enumerate() {
            match ch {
                'A' => start = (x, y),
                'B' => goal = (x, y),
                _ => {}
            }
        }

        maze.push(row);
    }

    if let Some(path) = bfs(&maze, start, goal, h, w) {
        println!("{}", path.len());
        for (x, y) in path {
            println!("{} {}", x, y);
        }
    } else {
        println!("0");
    }
}

fn bfs(maze: &[Vec<char>], start: (usize, usize), goal: (usize, usize), h: usize, w: usize) -> Option<Vec<(usize, usize)>> {
    if start == goal {
        return Some(vec![start]);
    }

    let mut queue = VecDeque::new();
    let mut visited = vec![vec![false; w]; h];
    let mut parent = vec![vec![None; w]; h];

    queue.push_back(start);
    visited[start.1][start.0] = true;

    let directions = [(0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)];

    while let Some((x, y)) = queue.pop_front() {
        if (x, y) == goal {
            let mut path = Vec::new();
            let mut curr = goal;
            while let Some(p) = parent[curr.1][curr.0] {
                path.push(curr);
                curr = p;
            }
            path.push(start);
            path.reverse();
            return Some(path);
        }

        for (dx, dy) in &directions {
            let nx = (x as i32 + dx) as usize;
            let ny = (y as i32 + dy) as usize;

            if nx < w && ny < h && !visited[ny][nx] && maze[ny][nx] != '#' {
                visited[ny][nx] = true;
                parent[ny][nx] = Some((x, y));
                queue.push_back((nx, ny));
            }
        }
    }

    None
}

Given fixed-length stock material and a shopping list of smaller pieces to cut, use as few stock pieces as possible. Every requested piece must be cut from somewhere, but any leftover material is wasted — so packing the cuts tightly matters.

This is essentially a bin-packing problem and is NP-hard. Subpasses scale from a handful of cuts up to millions, forcing the AI to write code that is both correct and fast. The baseline uses a simple first-fit-decreasing heuristic.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        // Read input
        string[] firstLine = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        int n = int.Parse(firstLine[0]);
        int stockLength = int.Parse(firstLine[1]);

        string[] cutsInput = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        int[] cuts = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            cuts[i] = int.Parse(cutsInput[i]);
        }

        // Create list of (cut_length, original_index) and sort by length descending
        var sortedCuts = new List<(int length, int index)>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            sortedCuts.Add((cuts[i], i));
        }
        sortedCuts.Sort((a, b) => b.length.CompareTo(a.length));

        // Bin packing using First Fit Decreasing
        var stocks = new List<List<int>>();
        var stockRemaining = new List<int>();

        foreach (var (length, index) in sortedCuts)
        {
            // Find first stock with enough space
            int stockIdx = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < stocks.Count; i++)
            {
                if (stockRemaining[i] >= length)
                {
                    stockIdx = i;
                    break;
                }
            }

            // If no suitable stock, create a new one
            if (stockIdx == -1)
            {
                stocks.Add(new List<int>());
                stockRemaining.Add(stockLength);
                stockIdx = stocks.Count - 1;
            }

            // Add cut to stock
            stocks[stockIdx].Add(index);
            stockRemaining[stockIdx] -= length;
        }

        // Output
        Console.WriteLine(stocks.Count);
        foreach (var stock in stocks)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", stock));
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

struct Rect {
    int w, h, id;
};

struct PlacedRect {
    int x, y, w, h;
};

struct Board {
    int width, height;
    std::vector<PlacedRect> placed;

    Board(int w, int h) : width(w), height(h) {}

    bool overlaps(int x, int y, int w, int h) const {
        for (const auto& r : placed) {
            if (!(x + w <= r.x || x >= r.x + r.w ||
                  y + h <= r.y || y >= r.y + r.h)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    bool canPlace(int x, int y, int w, int h) const {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x + w <= width && y + h <= height &&
               !overlaps(x, y, w, h);
    }

    bool tryPlace(int w, int h, int& outX, int& outY, bool useBrute) {
        if (useBrute && (long long)width * height <= 500 * 500) {
            // Brute force for small boards
            for (int y = 0; y <= height - h; y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x <= width - w; x++) {
                    if (canPlace(x, y, w, h)) {
                        placed.push_back({x, y, w, h});
                        outX = x;
                        outY = y;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Heuristic: try positions adjacent to placed rectangles
            std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> candidates;
            candidates.push_back({0, 0});

            for (const auto& r : placed) {
                if (r.x + r.w <= width) candidates.push_back({r.x + r.w, r.y});
                if (r.y + r.h <= height) candidates.push_back({r.x, r.y + r.h});
            }

            // Try candidate positions
            for (auto [x, y] : candidates) {
                if (canPlace(x, y, w, h)) {
                    placed.push_back({x, y, w, h});
                    outX = x;
                    outY = y;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, boardW, boardH;
    std::cin >> n >> boardW >> boardH;

    std::vector<Rect> rects(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        std::cin >> rects[i].w >> rects[i].h;
        rects[i].id = i;
    }

    // Sort by area descending (larger rectangles first)
    std::sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
        return (long long)a.w * a.h > (long long)b.w * b.h;
    });

    bool useBruteForce = n <= 100;

    std::vector<Board> boards;
    std::vector<std::array<int, 4>> placements(n); // {board, x, y, rotated}

    for (const auto& rect : rects) {
        bool placed = false;

        // Try to place in existing boards
        for (int b = 0; b < boards.size() && !placed; b++) {
            int x, y;

            // Try without rotation
            if (boards[b].tryPlace(rect.w, rect.h, x, y, useBruteForce)) {
                placements[rect.id] = {b, x, y, 0};
                placed = true;
            }
            // Try with rotation
            else if (rect.w != rect.h && boards[b].tryPlace(rect.h, rect.w, x, y, useBruteForce)) {
                placements[rect.id] = {b, x, y, 1};
                placed = true;
            }
        }

        // Create new board if needed
        if (!placed) {
            boards.emplace_back(boardW, boardH);
            int b = boards.size() - 1;
            int x, y;

            if (boards[b].tryPlace(rect.w, rect.h, x, y, useBruteForce)) {
                placements[rect.id] = {b, x, y, 0};
            } else if (rect.w != rect.h && boards[b].tryPlace(rect.h, rect.w, x, y, useBruteForce)) {
                placements[rect.id] = {b, x, y, 1};
            }
        }
    }

    // Output results
    std::cout << boards.size() << "\n";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        auto p = placements[i];
        std::cout << p[0] << " " << p[1] << " " << p[2] << " " << p[3] << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, Read};
use std::f64::consts::PI;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Polygon {
    vertices: Vec<Point>,
}

impl Polygon {
    fn translate(&self, dx: f64, dy: f64) -> Self {
        Polygon {
            vertices: self
                .vertices
                .iter()
                .map(|p| Point {
                    x: p.x + dx,
                    y: p.y + dy,
                })
                .collect(),
        }
    }

    fn rotate(&self, angle: f64) -> Self {
        let cos_a = angle.cos();
        let sin_a = angle.sin();
        Polygon {
            vertices: self
                .vertices
                .iter()
                .map(|p| Point {
                    x: p.x * cos_a - p.y * sin_a,
                    y: p.x * sin_a + p.y * cos_a,
                })
                .collect(),
        }
    }

    fn bounds(&self) -> (f64, f64, f64, f64) {
        let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;

        for p in &self.vertices {
            min_x = min_x.min(p.x);
            min_y = min_y.min(p.y);
            max_x = max_x.max(p.x);
            max_y = max_y.max(p.y);
        }
        (min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y)
    }

    fn area(&self) -> f64 {
        let mut area = 0.0;
        let n = self.vertices.len();
        for i in 0..n {
            let j = (i + 1) % n;
            area += self.vertices[i].x * self.vertices[j].y;
            area -= self.vertices[j].x * self.vertices[i].y;
        }
        area.abs() / 2.0
    }
}

fn point_in_polygon(p: Point, polygon: &Polygon) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let n = polygon.vertices.len();
    let mut p1 = polygon.vertices[0];

    for i in 1..=n {
        let p2 = polygon.vertices[i % n];
        if p.y > p1.y.min(p2.y) {
            if p.y <= p1.y.max(p2.y) {
                if p.x <= p1.x.max(p2.x) {
                    if (p1.y - p2.y).abs() > 1e-10 {
                        let xinters =
                            (p.y - p1.y) * (p2.x - p1.x) / (p2.y - p1.y) + p1.x;
                        if (p1.x - p2.x).abs() < 1e-10 || p.x <= xinters {
                            inside = !inside;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        p1 = p2;
    }
    inside
}

fn polygon_fits_in_stock(piece: &Polygon, stock: &Polygon) -> bool {
    piece.vertices.iter().all(|v| point_in_polygon(*v, stock))
}

fn cross_product(o: Point, a: Point, b: Point) -> f64 {
    (a.x - o.x) * (b.y - o.y) - (a.y - o.y) * (b.x - o.x)
}

fn segments_intersect(p1: Point, p2: Point, p3: Point, p4: Point) -> bool {
    let d1 = cross_product(p3, p4, p1);
    let d2 = cross_product(p3, p4, p2);
    let d3 = cross_product(p1, p2, p3);
    let d4 = cross_product(p1, p2, p4);

    if ((d1 > 1e-10 && d2 < -1e-10) || (d1 < -1e-10 && d2 > 1e-10))
        && ((d3 > 1e-10 && d4 < -1e-10) || (d3 < -1e-10 && d4 > 1e-10))
    {
        return true;
    }
    false
}

fn polygons_overlap(poly1: &Polygon, poly2: &Polygon) -> bool {
    for v in &poly1.vertices {
        if point_in_polygon(*v, poly2) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    for v in &poly2.vertices {
        if point_in_polygon(*v, poly1) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    for i in 0..poly1.vertices.len() {
        let j = (i + 1) % poly1.vertices.len();
        for k in 0..poly2.vertices.len() {
            let l = (k + 1) % poly2.vertices.len();
            if segments_intersect(
                poly1.vertices[i],
                poly1.vertices[j],
                poly2.vertices[k],
                poly2.vertices[l],
            ) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    false
}

fn try_place_piece(
    piece: &Polygon,
    stock: &Polygon,
    stock_idx: usize,
    placed_pieces: &[(Polygon, usize)],
) -> Option<(f64, f64, f64)> {
    let num_rotations = if placed_pieces.len() < 500 { 16 } else { 8 };

    for rot_idx in 0..num_rotations {
        let angle = (rot_idx as f64) * PI * 2.0 / (num_rotations as f64);
        let rotated = piece.rotate(angle);

        let (px1, py1, px2, py2) = rotated.bounds();
        let piece_w = px2 - px1;
        let piece_h = py2 - py1;

        let (sx1, sy1, sx2, sy2) = stock.bounds();
        let stock_w = sx2 - sx1;
        let stock_h = sy2 - sy1;

        let dx = sx1 - px1 + (stock_w - piece_w) / 2.0;
        let dy = sy1 - py1 + (stock_h - piece_h) / 2.0;

        let placed_piece = rotated.translate(dx, dy);

        if !polygon_fits_in_stock(&placed_piece, stock) {
            continue;
        }

        let mut valid = true;
        for (other, other_stock) in placed_pieces {
            if stock_idx == *other_stock && polygons_overlap(&placed_piece, other) {
                valid = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if valid {
            return Some((dx, dy, angle));
        }
    }

    None
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();

    let lines: Vec<&str> = input.trim().lines().collect();
    let mut idx = 0;

    let header: Vec<&str> = lines[idx].split_whitespace().collect();
    let sv = header[0].parse::<usize>().unwrap();
    let np = header[1].parse::<usize>().unwrap();
    idx += 1;

    let mut stock_vertices = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..sv {
        let coords: Vec<&str> = lines[idx].split_whitespace().collect();
        stock_vertices.push(Point {
            x: coords[0].parse().unwrap(),
            y: coords[1].parse().unwrap(),
        });
        idx += 1;
    }
    let stock = Polygon { vertices: stock_vertices };

    let mut pieces = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..np {
        let pv = lines[idx].parse::<usize>().unwrap();
        idx += 1;
        let mut vertices = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..pv {
            let coords: Vec<&str> = lines[idx].split_whitespace().collect();
            vertices.push(Point {
                x: coords[0].parse().unwrap(),
                y: coords[1].parse().unwrap(),
            });
            idx += 1;
        }
        pieces.push(Polygon { vertices });
    }

    let mut placed_pieces: Vec<(Polygon, usize)> = Vec::new();
    let mut placements: Vec<(usize, f64, f64, f64)> = vec![(0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0); np];
    let mut num_stocks = 0;

    for (piece_idx, piece) in pieces.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut placed = false;

        for stock_idx in 0..num_stocks {
            if let Some((dx, dy, angle)) = try_place_piece(piece, &stock, stock_idx, &placed_pieces)
            {
                let placed_piece = piece.rotate(angle).translate(dx, dy);
                placed_pieces.push((placed_piece, stock_idx));
                placements[piece_idx] = (stock_idx, dx, dy, angle);
                placed = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if !placed {
            if let Some((dx, dy, angle)) = try_place_piece(piece, &stock, num_stocks, &placed_pieces)
            {
                let placed_piece = piece.rotate(angle).translate(dx, dy);
                placed_pieces.push((placed_piece, num_stocks));
                placements[piece_idx] = (num_stocks, dx, dy, angle);
                num_stocks += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    println!("{}", num_stocks);
    for (stock_idx, dx, dy, angle) in placements {
        println!("{} {} {} {}", stock_idx, dx, dy, angle);
    }
}

        let mut placed = false;

        for stock_idx in 0..num_stocks {
            if let Some((dx, dy, angle)) = try_place_piece(piece, &stock, stock_idx, &placed_pieces)
            {
                let placed_piece = piece.rotate(angle).translate(dx, dy);
                placed_pieces.push((placed_piece, stock_idx));
                placements[piece_idx] = (stock_idx, dx, dy, angle);
                placed = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if !placed {
            if let Some((dx, dy, angle)) = try_place_piece(piece, &stock, num_stocks, &placed_pieces)
            {
                let placed_piece = piece.rotate(angle).translate(dx, dy);
                placed_pieces.push((placed_piece, num_stocks));
                placements[piece_idx] = (num_stocks, dx, dy, angle);
                num_stocks += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    println!("{}", num_stocks);
    for (stock_idx, dx, dy, angle) in placements {
        println!("{} {} {} {}", stock_idx, dx, dy, angle);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class BinPacker3D
{
    static void Main()
    {
        var (polyVerts, polyFaces, containerW, containerH, containerD) = ParseInput();

        var solver = new Solver(containerW, containerH, containerD, polyVerts, polyFaces);
        var packed = solver.Pack();

        Console.WriteLine(packed.Count);
        foreach (var item in packed)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{item.tx} {item.ty} {item.tz} {item.qw} {item.qx} {item.qy} {item.qz}");
        }
    }

    static (List<Vector3>, List<(int,int,int)>, float, float, float) ParseInput()
    {
        var vf = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        int v = int.Parse(vf[0]);
        int f = int.Parse(vf[1]);

        var verts = new List<Vector3>();
        for (int i = 0; i < v; i++)
        {
            var xyz = Console.ReadLine().Split();
            verts.Add(new Vector3(float.Parse(xyz[0]), float.Parse(xyz[1]), float.Parse(xyz[2])));
        }

        var faces = new List<(int, int, int)>();
        for (int i = 0; i < f; i++)
        {
            var abc = Console.ReadLine().Split();
            faces.Add((int.Parse(abc[0]), int.Parse(abc[1]), int.Parse(abc[2])));
        }

        var whd = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        return (verts, faces, float.Parse(whd[0]), float.Parse(whd[1]), float.Parse(whd[2]));
    }
}

struct Vector3
{
    public float x, y, z;
    public Vector3(float x, float y, float z) { this.x = x; this.y = y; this.z = z; }
    public static Vector3 operator+(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.x+b.x, a.y+b.y, a.z+b.z);
    public static Vector3 operator-(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y, a.z-b.z);
    public static Vector3 operator*(Vector3 a, float s) => new Vector3(a.x*s, a.y*s, a.z*s);
    public static float Dot(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => a.x*b.x + a.y*b.y + a.z*b.z;
    public float Length => (float)Math.Sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z);
}

struct Quaternion
{
    public float w, x, y, z;
    public Quaternion(float w, float x, float y, float z) { this.w = w; this.x = x; this.y = y; this.z = z; }
    public static Quaternion Identity => new Quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0);

    public Quaternion Conjugate => new Quaternion(w, -x, -y, -z);

    public static Quaternion operator*(Quaternion a, Quaternion b)
    {
        return new Quaternion(
            a.w*b.w - a.x*b.x - a.y*b.y - a.z*b.z,
            a.w*b.x + a.x*b.w + a.y*b.z - a.z*b.y,
            a.w*b.y - a.x*b.z + a.y*b.w + a.z*b.x,
            a.w*b.z + a.x*b.y - a.y*b.x + a.z*b.w
        );
    }

    public Vector3 RotateVector(Vector3 v)
    {
        var qv = new Quaternion(0, v.x, v.y, v.z);
        var result = this * qv * Conjugate;
        return new Vector3(result.x, result.y, result.z);
    }

    public static Quaternion FromAxisAngle(Vector3 axis, float angle)
    {
        float halfAngle = angle / 2;
        float sinHalf = (float)Math.Sin(halfAngle);
        return new Quaternion((float)Math.Cos(halfAngle), axis.x*sinHalf, axis.y*sinHalf, axis.z*sinHalf);
    }
}

struct AABB
{
    public float minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ;

    public AABB(float minX, float minY, float minZ, float maxX, float maxY, float maxZ)
    {
        this.minX = minX; this.minY = minY; this.minZ = minZ;
        this.maxX = maxX; this.maxY = maxY; this.maxZ = maxZ;
    }

    public bool Intersects(AABB other)
    {
        return !(maxX < other.minX || minX > other.maxX ||
                 maxY < other.minY || minY > other.maxY ||
                 maxZ < other.minZ || minZ > other.maxZ);
    }

    public bool FitsInContainer(float w, float h, float d)
    {
        return minX >= 0 && maxX <= w && minY >= 0 && maxY <= h && minZ >= 0 && maxZ <= d;
    }
}

class Solver
{
    float containerW, containerH, containerD;
    List<Vector3> polyVerts;
    List<(int, int, int)> polyFaces;
    AABB polyAABB;
    List<PlacedItem> placed = new List<PlacedItem>();

    class PlacedItem
    {
        public float tx, ty, tz;
        public Quaternion q;
        public AABB aabb;
    }

    public Solver(float w, float h, float d, List<Vector3> verts, List<(int,int,int)> faces)
    {
        containerW = w;
        containerH = h;
        containerD = d;
        polyVerts = verts;
        polyFaces = faces;
        ComputeAABB();
    }

    void ComputeAABB()
    {
        float minX = float.MaxValue, minY = float.MaxValue, minZ = float.MaxValue;
        float maxX = float.MinValue, maxY = float.MinValue, maxZ = float.MinValue;

        foreach (var v in polyVerts)
        {
            minX = Math.Min(minX, v.x);
            minY = Math.Min(minY, v.y);
            minZ = Math.Min(minZ, v.z);
            maxX = Math.Max(maxX, v.x);
            maxY = Math.Max(maxY, v.y);
            maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, v.z);
        }

        polyAABB = new AABB(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ);
    }

    AABB TransformAABB(float tx, float ty, float tz, Quaternion q)
    {
        float minX = float.MaxValue, minY = float.MaxValue, minZ = float.MaxValue;
        float maxX = float.MinValue, maxY = float.MinValue, maxZ = float.MinValue;

        foreach (var v in polyVerts)
        {
            var rotated = q.RotateVector(v);
            var transformed = new Vector3(rotated.x + tx, rotated.y + ty, rotated.z + tz);

            minX = Math.Min(minX, transformed.x);
            minY = Math.Min(minY, transformed.y);
            minZ = Math.Min(minZ, transformed.z);
            maxX = Math.Max(maxX, transformed.x);
            maxY = Math.Max(maxY, transformed.y);
            maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, transformed.z);
        }

        return new AABB(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ);
    }

    bool CanPlace(float tx, float ty, float tz, Quaternion q)
    {
        var aabb = TransformAABB(tx, ty, tz, q);

        if (!aabb.FitsInContainer(containerW, containerH, containerD))
            return false;

        foreach (var item in placed)
        {
            if (aabb.Intersects(item.aabb))
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public List<(float tx, float ty, float tz, float qw, float qx, float qy, float qz)> Pack()
    {
        int maxAttempts = DetermineMaxAttempts();

        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++)
        {
            if (!TryPlaceItem())
                break;
        }

        return placed.Select(p => (p.tx, p.ty, p.tz, p.q.w, p.q.x, p.q.y, p.q.z)).ToList();
    }

    int DetermineMaxAttempts()
    {
        float volume = containerW * containerH * containerD;
        float polySize = (polyAABB.maxX - polyAABB.minX) *
                        (polyAABB.maxY - polyAABB.minY) *
                        (polyAABB.maxZ - polyAABB.minZ);

        if (polySize <= 0) return 1;

        int estimate = (int)(volume / polySize * 0.6f);

        if (volume < 1000) return Math.Min(estimate, 50);
        if (volume < 10000) return Math.Min(estimate, 200);
        if (volume < 100000) return Math.Min(estimate, 500);
        return Math.Min(estimate, 2000);
    }

    bool TryPlaceItem()
    {
        var rotations = GenerateRotations();

        int gridStep = containerW > 100 ? 10 : containerW > 50 ? 5 : 2;

        for (float x = 0; x < containerW; x += gridStep)
        {
            for (float y = 0; y < containerH; y += gridStep)
            {
                for (float z = 0; z < containerD; z += gridStep)
                {
                    foreach (var q in rotations)
                    {
                        if (CanPlace(x, y, z, q))
                        {
                            var aabb = TransformAABB(x, y, z, q);
                            placed.Add(new PlacedItem { tx = x, ty = y, tz = z, q = q, aabb = aabb });
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    Quaternion[] GenerateRotations()
    {
        var rotations = new List<Quaternion>
        {
            Quaternion.Identity,
            Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(1,0,0), (float)Math.PI/2),
            Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0,1,0), (float)Math.PI/2),
            Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0,0,1), (float)Math.PI/2),
            Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(1,0,0), (float)Math.PI),
            Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0,1,0), (float)Math.PI),
            Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0,0,1), (float)Math.PI),
        };

        return rotations.ToArray();
    }
}

Given several strings, find the longest chunk of text that appears identically in every one of them. For example, if the strings are “abcdef” and “xbcdey”, the answer is “bcde”.

Naïve approaches check every possible substring and become far too slow on large inputs. Subpasses increase the string lengths into the millions, so the AI must use efficient data structures or hashing. The baseline uses a simple library call that times out on the bigger cases.

Longest Common Substring - 3 short strings (7 chars)

View Code (2018 chars)
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore();

    vector<string> strings(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        getline(cin, strings[i]);
    }

    if (strings.empty()) {
        cout << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    // Find the smallest string - the LCS cannot be longer than this
    size_t minIdx = 0;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < strings.size(); i++) {
        if (strings[i].length() < strings[minIdx].length()) {
            minIdx = i;
        }
    }

    const string& smallest = strings[minIdx];

    // Try all lengths from longest to shortest
    for (size_t len = smallest.length(); len > 0; len--) {
        // Build set of all substrings of length len from the smallest string
        unordered_set<string> candidates;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + len <= smallest.length(); i++) {
            candidates.insert(smallest.substr(i, len));
        }

        // For each other string, intersect candidates
        for (size_t idx = 0; idx < strings.size(); idx++) {
            if (idx == minIdx) continue;

            const string& str = strings[idx];
            unordered_set<string> common;

            // Find which candidates appear in this string
            for (size_t i = 0; i + len <= str.length(); i++) {
                string sub = str.substr(i, len);
                if (candidates.count(sub)) {
                    common.insert(sub);
                }
            }

            candidates = common;

            // Early exit if no common substrings at this length
            if (candidates.empty()) break;
        }

        // If any candidates remain, they are common to all strings
        if (!candidates.empty()) {
            cout << *candidates.begin() << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // No common substring found
    cout << endl;
    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class MinesweeperSolver
{
    private int height;
    private int width;
    private char[,] board;
    private bool[,] isSafe;
    private bool[,] isMine;

    static void Main()
    {
        var solver = new MinesweeperSolver();
        solver.Solve();
    }

    void Solve()
    {
        ReadInput();
        SolveMinesweeper();
        OutputResults();
    }

    void ReadInput()
    {
        var firstLine = Console.ReadLine().TrimStart('﻿').Split();
        height = int.Parse(firstLine[0]);
        width = int.Parse(firstLine[1]);

        board = new char[height, width];
        isSafe = new bool[height, width];
        isMine = new bool[height, width];

        for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
        {
            string line = Console.ReadLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
            {
                board[i, j] = j < line.Length ? line[j] : ' ';

                if (board[i, j] == '*')
                    isMine[i, j] = true;
                else if (board[i, j] != ' ')
                    isSafe[i, j] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    void SolveMinesweeper()
    {
        bool changed = true;
        while (changed)
        {
            changed = false;

            for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
            {
                for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
                {
                    if (char.IsDigit(board[i, j]))
                    {
                        int mineCount = int.Parse(board[i, j].ToString());
                        ApplyConstraint(i, j, mineCount, ref changed);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void ApplyConstraint(int row, int col, int mineCount, ref bool changed)
    {
        var neighbors = GetNeighbors(row, col);

        int flaggedMines = neighbors.Count(n => isMine[n.Item1, n.Item2]);
        int unknownCount = neighbors.Count(n => !isSafe[n.Item1, n.Item2] && !isMine[n.Item1, n.Item2]);

        if (flaggedMines == mineCount)
        {
            foreach (var (r, c) in neighbors)
            {
                if (!isSafe[r, c] && !isMine[r, c])
                {
                    isSafe[r, c] = true;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
        else if (flaggedMines + unknownCount == mineCount)
        {
            foreach (var (r, c) in neighbors)
            {
                if (!isSafe[r, c] && !isMine[r, c])
                {
                    isMine[r, c] = true;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    List<(int, int)> GetNeighbors(int row, int col)
    {
        var neighbors = new List<(int, int)>();
        for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++)
        {
            for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++)
            {
                if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                int nr = row + dr;
                int nc = col + dc;
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < height && nc >= 0 && nc < width)
                    neighbors.Add((nr, nc));
            }
        }
        return neighbors;
    }

    void OutputResults()
    {
        var safeCells = new List<(int, int)>();

        for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
            {
                if (isSafe[i, j] && board[i, j] == ' ')
                {
                    safeCells.Add((j, i));
                }
            }
        }

        Console.WriteLine(safeCells.Count);
        foreach (var (x, y) in safeCells)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{x} {y}");
        }
    }
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
struct Vec3 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64,
}

impl Vec3 {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> Self {
        Vec3 { x, y, z }
    }

    fn normalize(&self) -> Vec3 {
        let len = (self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y + self.z * self.z).sqrt();
        if len > 1e-10 {
            Vec3 {
                x: self.x / len,
                y: self.y / len,
                z: self.z / len,
            }
        } else {
            *self
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
struct Quaternion {
    w: f64,
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64,
}

impl Quaternion {
    fn identity() -> Self {
        Quaternion {
            w: 1.0,
            x: 0.0,
            y: 0.0,
            z: 0.0,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Tetrahedron {
    position: Vec3,
    rotation: Quaternion,
    scale: f64,
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let reader = stdin.lock();
    let mut lines = reader.lines();

    // Parse number of vertices
    let nv_line = lines.next().unwrap().unwrap();
    let nv: usize = nv_line.trim().parse().unwrap();

    // Parse polygon vertices
    let mut vertices = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..nv {
        let line = lines.next().unwrap().unwrap();
        let parts: Vec<&str> = line.trim().split_whitespace().collect();
        let x: f64 = parts[0].parse().unwrap();
        let y: f64 = parts[1].parse().unwrap();
        vertices.push(Vec3::new(x, y, 0.0));
    }

    // Parse sun direction
    let sun_line = lines.next().unwrap().unwrap();
    let parts: Vec<&str> = sun_line.trim().split_whitespace().collect();
    let sx: f64 = parts[0].parse().unwrap();
    let sy: f64 = parts[1].parse().unwrap();
    let sz: f64 = parts[2].parse().unwrap();
    let _sun_dir = Vec3::new(sx, sy, sz).normalize();

    // Calculate bounding box of polygon
    let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
    let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;

    for v in &vertices {
        min_x = min_x.min(v.x);
        max_x = max_x.max(v.x);
        min_y = min_y.min(v.y);
        max_y = max_y.max(v.y);
    }

    let width = (max_x - min_x).abs().max(0.001);
    let height = (max_y - min_y).abs().max(0.001);
    let area = width * height;

    // Adaptive grid sizing based on polygon area
    let grid_size = if area < 10.0 {
        1
    } else if area < 100.0 {
        1
    } else if area < 1000.0 {
        2
    } else if area < 10000.0 {
        3
    } else {
        ((area / 1000.0).sqrt().ceil() as usize).max(3)
    };

    let cell_width = width / grid_size as f64;
    let cell_height = height / grid_size as f64;

    let mut tetrahedrons = Vec::new();

    // Place tetrahedrons in grid pattern
    for i in 0..grid_size {
        for j in 0..grid_size {
            let center_x = min_x + (i as f64 + 0.5) * cell_width;
            let center_y = min_y + (j as f64 + 0.5) * cell_height;

            // Scale tetrahedron to cover the cell
            let base_scale = ((cell_width + cell_height) / 2.0 * 0.75).min(10.0);
            let scale = base_scale.max(0.1);

            // Position above ground to cast shadows
            let z_pos = (scale * 1.5).max(0.5);

            tetrahedrons.push(Tetrahedron {
                position: Vec3::new(center_x, center_y, z_pos),
                rotation: Quaternion::identity(),
                scale,
            });
        }
    }

    // Output tetrahedrons
    println!("{}", tetrahedrons.len());
    for tet in &tetrahedrons {
        println!(
            "{:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6}",
            tet.position.x,
            tet.position.y,
            tet.position.z,
            tet.rotation.w,
            tet.rotation.x,
            tet.rotation.y,
            tet.rotation.z,
            tet.scale
        );
    }
}

Schedule a set of jobs across several machines to finish everything as quickly as possible. Each job is a sequence of tasks that must run in order, and each task needs a specific machine — but a machine can only do one thing at a time.

This classic factory-scheduling problem is NP-hard. Subpasses increase the number of jobs and machines. The baseline greedily starts whichever task can begin earliest.

Job-Shop Scheduling - 3 jobs, 2 machines

View Code (1837 chars)
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int J, M;
    cin >> J >> M;

    vector<vector<int>> machines(J);
    vector<vector<int>> durations(J);

    // Parse input
    for (int j = 0; j < J; j++) {
        int T;
        cin >> T;
        machines[j].resize(T);
        durations[j].resize(T);
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            cin >> machines[j][t] >> durations[j][t];
        }
    }

    // Track when each machine will be free
    vector<long long> machine_free_time(M, 0);

    // Track start times for each task
    vector<vector<long long>> start_times(J);

    // Greedy scheduling: process jobs sequentially
    // For each job, schedule tasks as early as possible
    for (int j = 0; j < J; j++) {
        int T = machines[j].size();
        start_times[j].resize(T);

        long long job_complete_time = 0;

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            int m = machines[j][t];
            int d = durations[j][t];

            // Task can start when both:
            // 1. Previous task in this job is done (job_complete_time)
            // 2. Machine is free (machine_free_time[m])
            long long start_time = max(job_complete_time, machine_free_time[m]);
            start_times[j][t] = start_time;

            // Update machine free time
            machine_free_time[m] = start_time + d;

            // Update job completion time
            job_complete_time = start_time + d;
        }
    }

    // Output results
    for (int j = 0; j < J; j++) {
        for (int t = 0; t < (int)start_times[j].size(); t++) {
            if (t > 0) cout << " ";
            cout << start_times[j][t] << " " << machines[j][t];
        }
        cout << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

You are solving a 3D Bin Packing problem with axis-aligned boxes in C#.

Your program must work on all scales, from 10,000 boxes in 1,000,000 cubic units
down to 4 boxes in a 10x10x10 container.

**Input format (stdin):**
Line 1: N W H D (number of boxes, container width, height, depth)
Next N lines: w h d (box dimensions)

**Output format (stdout):**
Line 1: packed_count
Next packed_count lines: box_index x y z (0-indexed box index and corner position)

**Critical Requirements:**
1. **Scalability**: Your algorithm must adapt based on container size and number of boxes
