using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class Program
{
    struct Box
    {
        public int Index;
        public int W, H, D;
        public int Volume => W * H * D;
    }

    struct Placement
    {
        public int Index;
        public int X, Y, Z;
        public int W, H, D;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        var line = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        int n = int.Parse(line[0]);
        int containerW = int.Parse(line[1]);
        int containerH = int.Parse(line[2]);
        int containerD = int.Parse(line[3]);

        var boxes = new Box[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            var dims = Console.ReadLine().Split();
            boxes[i] = new Box
            {
                Index = i,
                W = int.Parse(dims[0]),
                H = int.Parse(dims[1]),
                D = int.Parse(dims[2])
            };
        }

        var placements = PackBoxes(boxes, containerW, containerH, containerD);

        Console.WriteLine(placements.Count);
        foreach (var p in placements)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{p.Index} {p.X} {p.Y} {p.Z}");
        }
    }

    static List<Placement> PackBoxes(Box[] boxes, int cw, int ch, int cd)
    {
        var placements = new List<Placement>();
        var placed = new HashSet<int>();

        // Sort boxes by volume descending for better packing
        var sortedIndices = Enumerable.Range(0, boxes.Length)
            .OrderByDescending(i => boxes[i].Volume)
            .ToList();

        foreach (int idx in sortedIndices)
        {
            if (placed.Contains(idx)) continue;

            // Try all 6 orientations
            var orientations = GetOrientations(boxes[idx].W, boxes[idx].H, boxes[idx].D);

            bool placed_box = false;
            foreach (var (w, h, d) in orientations)
            {
                if (TryPlaceBox(idx, w, h, d, placements, cw, ch, cd, out int x, out int y, out int z))
                {
                    placements.Add(new Placement { Index = idx, X = x, Y = y, Z = z, W = w, H = h, D = d });
                    placed.Add(idx);
                    placed_box = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        return placements;
    }

    static List<(int, int, int)> GetOrientations(int w, int h, int d)
    {
        var set = new HashSet<(int, int, int)>();
        var dims = new[] { w, h, d };

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                    if (i != j && j != k && i != k)
                        set.Add((dims[i], dims[j], dims[k]));

        return set.ToList();
    }

    static bool TryPlaceBox(int index, int w, int h, int d, List<Placement> placements, int cw, int ch, int cd, out int ox, out int oy, out int oz)
    {
        ox = oy = oz = 0;

        if (w > cw || h > ch || d > cd) return false;

        var candidates = new List<(int, int, int)> { (0, 0, 0) };

        foreach (var p in placements)
        {
            candidates.Add((p.X + p.W, p.Y, p.Z));
            candidates.Add((p.X, p.Y + p.H, p.Z));
            candidates.Add((p.X, p.Y, p.Z + p.D));
        }

        // Try candidates
        foreach (var (cx, cy, cz) in candidates.OrderBy(c => c.Item1 + c.Item2 + c.Item3))
        {
            if (cx + w > cw || cy + h > ch || cz + d > cd) continue;

            bool valid = true;
            foreach (var p in placements)
            {
                if (BoxesOverlap(cx, cy, cz, w, h, d, p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W, p.H, p.D))
                {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (valid)
            {
                ox = cx;
                oy = cy;
                oz = cz;
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    static bool BoxesOverlap(int x1, int y1, int z1, int w1, int h1, int d1, int x2, int y2, int z2, int w2, int h2, int d2)
    {
        return !(x1 + w1 <= x2 || x2 + w2 <= x1 ||
                 y1 + h1 <= y2 || y2 + h2 <= y1 ||
                 z1 + d1 <= z2 || z2 + d2 <= z1);
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, flow, rev;
};

class Dinic {
public:
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<int> level, iter;
    int n;

    Dinic(int n) : n(n), graph(n), level(n), iter(n) {}

    void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        graph[from].push_back({to, cap, 0, (int)graph[to].size()});
        graph[to].push_back({from, 0, 0, (int)graph[from].size() - 1});
    }

    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto& e : graph[v]) {
                if (e.cap > e.flow && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0;
    }

    int dfs(int v, int t, int pushed) {
        if (v == t || pushed == 0) return pushed;
        for (int& cid = iter[v]; cid < (int)graph[v].size(); cid++) {
            Edge& e = graph[v][cid];
            if (level[v] + 1 != level[e.to] || e.cap <= e.flow)
                continue;

            int tr = dfs(e.to, t, min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (tr > 0) {
                e.flow += tr;
                graph[e.to][e.rev].flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            fill(iter.begin(), iter.end(), 0);
            while (int pushed = dfs(s, t, INT_MAX)) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    vector<bool> get_source_side(int s) {
        vector<bool> reachable(n, false);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        reachable[s] = true;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto& e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.cap > e.flow && !reachable[e.to]) {
                    reachable[e.to] = true;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }

        return reachable;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<pair<int,int>> edges(m);

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        cin >> edges[i].first >> edges[i].second;
    }

    if (m == 0) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int min_cut = INT_MAX;
    vector<pair<int,int>> result_cut;

    // Try multiple vertex pairs to find minimum cut
    vector<pair<int,int>> candidates;

    // Use edge endpoints as candidates
    for (auto& edge : edges) {
        candidates.push_back(edge);
        if (candidates.size() >= min(10, (int)edges.size())) break;
    }

    for (auto& [s, t] : candidates) {
        Dinic mf(n);

        for (auto& [u, v] : edges) {
            mf.add_edge(u, v, 1);
            mf.add_edge(v, u, 1);
        }

        int flow = mf.max_flow(s, t);

        if (flow < min_cut) {
            min_cut = flow;

            vector<bool> source_side = mf.get_source_side(s);
            result_cut.clear();

            for (auto& [u, v] : edges) {
                if (source_side[u] && !source_side[v]) {
                    result_cut.push_back({u, v});
                } else if (!source_side[u] && source_side[v]) {
                    result_cut.push_back({v, u});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << min_cut << "\n";
    for (auto& [u, v] : result_cut) {
        cout << u << " " << v << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, flow, rev;
};

class Dinic {
public:
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<int> level, iter;
    int n;

    Dinic(int n) : n(n), graph(n), level(n), iter(n) {}

    void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        graph[from].push_back({to, cap, 0, (int)graph[to].size()});
        graph[to].push_back({from, 0, 0, (int)graph[from].size() - 1});
    }

    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto& e : graph[v]) {
                if (e.cap > e.flow && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0;
    }

    int dfs(int v, int t, int pushed) {
        if (v == t || pushed == 0) return pushed;
        for (int& cid = iter[v]; cid < (int)graph[v].size(); cid++) {
            Edge& e = graph[v][cid];
            if (level[v] + 1 != level[e.to] || e.cap <= e.flow)
                continue;

            int tr = dfs(e.to, t, min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (tr > 0) {
                e.flow += tr;
                graph[e.to][e.rev].flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            fill(iter.begin(), iter.end(), 0);
            while (int pushed = dfs(s, t, INT_MAX)) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    vector<bool> get_source_side(int s) {
        vector<bool> reachable(n, false);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        reachable[s] = true;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto& e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.cap > e.flow && !reachable[e.to]) {
                    reachable[e.to] = true;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }

        return reachable;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<pair<int,int>> edges(m);

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        cin >> edges[i].first >> edges[i].second;
    }

    if (m == 0) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int min_cut = INT_MAX;
    vector<pair<int,int>> result_cut;

    // Try multiple vertex pairs to find minimum cut
    vector<pair<int,int>> candidates;

    // Use edge endpoints as candidates
    for (auto& edge : edges) {
        candidates.push_back(edge);
        if (candidates.size() >= min(10, (int)edges.size())) break;
    }

    for (auto& [s, t] : candidates) {
        Dinic mf(n);

        for (auto& [u, v] : edges) {
            mf.add_edge(u, v, 1);
            mf.add_edge(v, u, 1);
        }

        int flow = mf.max_flow(s, t);

        if (flow < min_cut) {
            min_cut = flow;

            vector<bool> source_side = mf.get_source_side(s);
            result_cut.clear();

            for (auto& [u, v] : edges) {
                if (source_side[u] && !source_side[v]) {
                    result_cut.push_back({u, v});
                } else if (!source_side[u] && source_side[v]) {
                    result_cut.push_back({v, u});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << min_cut << "\n";
    for (auto& [u, v] : result_cut) {
        cout << u << " " << v << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

You are writing a C# program to solve a mining problem in a simplified 3D voxel space.

**Constraints:**
1. Can only dig dirt that is exposed from above or a side.
2. Dug dirt must be dumped somewhere - at a location not blocking future digging
3. Maximum uphill slope - 1 Z voxel per X/Y voxel.
4. Dumped dirt becomes a new obstacle (plan carefully!)
5. Goal is to get valuable ore to a processing plant located at x=0, y=0
6. Ground is stable and solid, and you can dig under any voxel without fear of it collapsing
so long as it's connected to the earth. If you disconnect a voxel(s), it will collapse.

The voxel grid size has 10x more precision in Z than X/Y. So 10x10x100 is a cube.

**Input header format (stdin - space delimited. Ends with newline):**
```
XVoxelCount YVoxelCount ZVoxelCount XBlockSize YBlockSize ZBlockSize
```
Counts are human readable integers. BlockSize are human readable decimal numbers.

After the newline, voxels then follow in bytes, like this python psuedocode:
```
for x in range(XVoxelCount):
for y in range(YVoxelCount):
for z in range(ZVoxelCount):
d = readByte(stdin)
massInTonnes = d % 16
valuePerTonne = d // 16
addVoxel(d)
```

Each peice of dirt needs to be moved to its new location - you need to trace the
path in X and Y (4-connected / manhatten steps) and ensure that the path doesn't climb uphill
or downhill more than 1 Z voxel for every X/Y voxel.

**Output format (stdout / newline seperated):**
```
M (number of operations)
N digX digY digZ stepX1 stepY1 stepX2 stepY2 (N steps) destX destY (for each operation)
```

If dumping valuable ore at the processing plant, the voxel ceases to exist. If a voxel is
dumped elsewhere, it is dumped on top of the ground, raising the ground by 1 voxel. It can
be dug again and moved later if required.

Every unit of mass requires $1 of fuel to move one voxel in X or Y when flat, or $5 of fuel
to go up a 10% slope. Downhill is free.

Getting valuable ore to your processing plant pays $1000 per unit of mass per unit of value.
The most valuable ore (#15) pays $15,000 per ton, so the most a single dump truck load can gross
is $225,000.

(Dumping junk ore at the processing plant causes damage to the plant, costing $1000 per ton.)

1. Program must compile with .NET/csc
2. Read from stdin, write to stdout

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class Mining
{
    struct Node
    {
        public int X, Y, Cost;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        string header = Console.ReadLine();
        var parts = header.Split(' ');
        int xv = int.Parse(parts[0]);
        int yv = int.Parse(parts[1]);
        int zv = int.Parse(parts[2]);
        double xb = double.Parse(parts[3]);
        double yb = double.Parse(parts[4]);
        double zb = double.Parse(parts[5]);

        byte[,,] voxels = new byte[xv, yv, zv];

        // Read voxel data from stdin
        for (int x = 0; x < xv; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < yv; y++)
            {
                for (int z = 0; z < zv; z++)
                {
                    int val = Console.Read();
                    if (val == -1) break;
                    voxels[x, y, z] = (byte)val;
                }
            }
        }

        var operations = new List<string>();

        // Find all accessible voxels with value
        var oreList = new List<(int x, int y, int z, int mass, int value)>();

        for (int x = 0; x < xv; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < yv; y++)
            {
                for (int z = 0; z < zv; z++)
                {
                    byte b = voxels[x, y, z];
                    if (b > 0)
                    {
                        int mass = b % 16;
                        int value = b / 16;
                        if (value > 0 && CanDig(voxels, x, y, z, xv, yv, zv))
                        {
                            oreList.Add((x, y, z, mass, value));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Sort by total value descending (value * mass)
        oreList.Sort((a, b) => (b.value * b.mass).CompareTo(a.value * a.mass));

        // Process ore - limit to avoid timeout
        int processed = 0;
        int maxOps = Math.Min(200, oreList.Count);

        foreach (var ore in oreList.Take(maxOps))
        {
            int x = ore.x, y = ore.y, z = ore.z;

            if (!CanDig(voxels, x, y, z, xv, yv, zv))
                continue;

            // Try to find path to processing plant
            var path = FindPath(voxels, x, y, z, 0, 0, xv, yv, zv);

            if (path != null && path.Count > 0)
            {
                string op = $"{path.Count} {x} {y} {z}";
                foreach (var p in path)
                {
                    op += $" {p.Item1} {p.Item2}";
                }
                op += " 0 0";
                operations.Add(op);
                voxels[x, y, z] = 0;
                processed++;

                if (processed >= 100)
                    break;
            }
        }

        Console.WriteLine(operations.Count);
        foreach (var op in operations)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(op);
        }
    }

    static bool CanDig(byte[,,] voxels, int x, int y, int z, int xv, int yv, int zv)
    {
        if (voxels[x, y, z] == 0) return false;

        // Exposed from above
        if (z == zv - 1 || voxels[x, y, z + 1] == 0) return true;

        // Exposed from side
        if ((x > 0 && voxels[x - 1, y, z] == 0) || (x < xv - 1 && voxels[x + 1, y, z] == 0) ||
            (y > 0 && voxels[x, y - 1, z] == 0) || (y < yv - 1 && voxels[x, y + 1, z] == 0))
            return true;

        return false;
    }

    static List<Tuple<int, int>> FindPath(byte[,,] voxels, int fromX, int fromY, int fromZ,
        int toX, int toY, int xv, int yv, int zv)
    {
        var cameFrom = new Dictionary<Tuple<int, int>, Tuple<int, int>>();
        var gScore = new Dictionary<Tuple<int, int>, int>();
        var visited = new HashSet<Tuple<int, int>>();
        var open = new List<Node>();

        var start = Tuple.Create(fromX, fromY);
        open.Add(new Node { X = fromX, Y = fromY, Cost = 0 });
        gScore[start] = 0;

        int iterations = 0;
        int maxIterations = 50000;

        while (open.Count > 0 && iterations < maxIterations)
        {
            iterations++;

            // Get node with lowest cost
            int minIdx = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i < open.Count; i++)
            {
                if (open[i].Cost < open[minIdx].Cost)
                    minIdx = i;
            }
            var current = open[minIdx];
            open.RemoveAt(minIdx);

            var currTuple = Tuple.Create(current.X, current.Y);
            if (visited.Contains(currTuple))
                continue;
            visited.Add(currTuple);

            if (current.X == toX && current.Y == toY)
            {
                var path = new List<Tuple<int, int>> { currTuple };
                var curr = currTuple;
                while (cameFrom.ContainsKey(curr))
                {
                    curr = cameFrom[curr];
                    path.Add(curr);
                }
                path.Reverse();
                return path.ConvertAll(t => new Tuple<int, int>(t.Item1, t.Item2));
            }

            int h1 = GetHeight(voxels, current.X, current.Y, zv);

            int[][] dirs = new int[][] { new int[] { 0, 1 }, new int[] { 0, -1 }, new int[] { 1, 0 }, new int[] { -1, 0 } };
            foreach (var dir in dirs)
            {
                int nx = current.X + dir[0];
                int ny = current.Y + dir[1];

                if (nx < 0 || nx >= xv || ny < 0 || ny >= yv) continue;

                var nTuple = Tuple.Create(nx, ny);
                if (visited.Contains(nTuple)) continue;

                int h2 = GetHeight(voxels, nx, ny, zv);

                // Check slope constraint
                if (Math.Abs(h2 - h1) > 1) continue;

                int tentativeG = gScore[currTuple] + 1;

                if (!gScore.ContainsKey(nTuple) || tentativeG < gScore[nTuple])
                {
                    cameFrom[nTuple] = currTuple;
                    gScore[nTuple] = tentativeG;
                    int h = Math.Abs(nx - toX) + Math.Abs(ny - toY);
                    int priority = tentativeG + h;
                    open.Add(new Node { X = nx, Y = ny, Cost = priority });
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    static int GetHeight(byte[,,] voxels, int x, int y, int zv)
    {
        for (int z = zv - 1; z >= 0; z--)
        {
            if (voxels[x, y, z] != 0)
                return z + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Sample {
    depth: f64,
    properties: Vec<f64>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Drillhole {
    id: String,
    start: (f64, f64, f64),
    direction: (f64, f64, f64),
    length: f64,
    samples: Vec<Sample>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Suspect {
    hole_id: String,
    sample_idx: usize,
    property_idx: usize,
    property_name: String,
    confidence: f64,
}

fn normalize_vector(v: (f64, f64, f64)) -> (f64, f64, f64) {
    let len = (v.0 * v.0 + v.1 * v.1 + v.2 * v.2).sqrt();
    if len > 0.0 {
        (v.0 / len, v.1 / len, v.2 / len)
    } else {
        (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    }
}

fn get_sample_position(hole: &Drillhole, depth: f64) -> (f64, f64, f64) {
    let dir = normalize_vector(hole.direction);
    (
        hole.start.0 + dir.0 * depth,
        hole.start.1 + dir.1 * depth,
        hole.start.2 + dir.2 * depth,
    )
}

fn distance(p1: (f64, f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64, f64)) -> f64 {
    let dx = p1.0 - p2.0;
    let dy = p1.1 - p2.1;
    let dz = p1.2 - p2.2;
    (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt()
}

fn detect_outliers_small(
    holes: &[Drillhole],
    property_names: &[String],
) -> Vec<Suspect> {
    let mut suspects = Vec::new();
    let k = 5.min((holes.len() * 10).min(50));

    for (hole_idx, hole) in holes.iter().enumerate() {
        for (sample_idx, sample) in hole.samples.iter().enumerate() {
            let sample_pos = get_sample_position(hole, sample.depth);

            for (prop_idx, &value) in sample.properties.iter().enumerate() {
                let mut neighbors = Vec::new();

                for (other_hole_idx, other_hole) in holes.iter().enumerate() {
                    for (other_sample_idx, other_sample) in other_hole.samples.iter().enumerate() {
                        if hole_idx == other_hole_idx && sample_idx == other_sample_idx {
                            continue;
                        }

                        let other_pos = get_sample_position(other_hole, other_sample.depth);
                        let dist = distance(sample_pos, other_pos);

                        if prop_idx < other_sample.properties.len() {
                            neighbors.push((
                                dist,
                                other_sample.properties[prop_idx],
                            ));
                        }
                    }
                }

                if neighbors.is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }

                neighbors.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
                let k_neighbors: Vec<f64> = neighbors.iter().take(k).map(|(_, v)| *v).collect();

                if k_neighbors.len() < 3 {
                    continue;
                }

                let mean: f64 = k_neighbors.iter().sum::<f64>() / k_neighbors.len() as f64;
                let variance: f64 = k_neighbors
                    .iter()
                    .map(|v| (v - mean).powi(2))
                    .sum::<f64>()
                    / k_neighbors.len() as f64;
                let stddev = variance.sqrt();

                if stddev > 0.0 {
                    let z_score = (value - mean).abs() / stddev;
                    if z_score > 2.5 {
                        let confidence = (z_score - 2.5) / (z_score.max(3.0) - 2.5);
                        suspects.push(Suspect {
                            hole_id: hole.id.clone(),
                            sample_idx,
                            property_idx: prop_idx,
                            property_name: property_names[prop_idx].clone(),
                            confidence: confidence.min(1.0),
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspects
}

fn detect_outliers_large(
    holes: &[Drillhole],
    property_names: &[String],
) -> Vec<Suspect> {
    let mut suspects = Vec::new();

    for (hole_idx, hole) in holes.iter().enumerate() {
        for (sample_idx, sample) in hole.samples.iter().enumerate() {
            for (prop_idx, &value) in sample.properties.iter().enumerate() {
                let mut local_values = Vec::new();

                let depth = sample.depth;
                let search_radius = (hole.length / 20.0).max(1.0);

                for (check_sample_idx, check_sample) in hole.samples.iter().enumerate() {
                    if (check_sample.depth - depth).abs() <= search_radius {
                        local_values.push(check_sample.properties[prop_idx]);
                    }
                }

                if local_values.len() < 3 {
                    continue;
                }

                let mean: f64 = local_values.iter().sum::<f64>() / local_values.len() as f64;
                let variance: f64 = local_values
                    .iter()
                    .map(|v| (v - mean).powi(2))
                    .sum::<f64>()
                    / local_values.len() as f64;
                let stddev = variance.sqrt();

                if stddev > 1e-10 {
                    let z_score = (value - mean).abs() / stddev;
                    if z_score > 3.0 {
                        let confidence = ((z_score - 3.0) / (z_score.max(4.0) - 3.0)).min(1.0);
                        suspects.push(Suspect {
                            hole_id: hole.id.clone(),
                            sample_idx,
                            property_idx: prop_idx,
                            property_name: property_names[prop_idx].clone(),
                            confidence,
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspects
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut reader = stdin.lock();
    let mut line = String::new();

    reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
    let parts: Vec<&str> = line.trim().split_whitespace().collect();
    let num_holes: usize = parts[0].parse().unwrap();
    let num_properties: usize = parts[1].parse().unwrap();

    line.clear();
    reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
    let property_names: Vec<String> = line
        .trim()
        .split_whitespace()
        .take(num_properties)
        .map(|s| s.to_string())
        .collect();

    let mut holes = Vec::new();

    for _ in 0..num_holes {
        line.clear();
        reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
        let parts: Vec<&str> = line.trim().split_whitespace().collect();

        let id = parts[0].to_string();
        let start_x: f64 = parts[1].parse().unwrap();
        let start_y: f64 = parts[2].parse().unwrap();
        let start_z: f64 = parts[3].parse().unwrap();
        let dir_x: f64 = parts[4].parse().unwrap();
        let dir_y: f64 = parts[5].parse().unwrap();
        let dir_z: f64 = parts[6].parse().unwrap();
        let length: f64 = parts[7].parse().unwrap();
        let num_samples: usize = parts[8].parse().unwrap();

        let mut samples = Vec::new();

        for _ in 0..num_samples {
            line.clear();
            reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
            let sample_parts: Vec<&str> = line.trim().split_whitespace().collect();

            let depth: f64 = sample_parts[0].parse().unwrap();
            let properties: Vec<f64> = sample_parts[1..]
                .iter()
                .take(num_properties)
                .map(|s| s.parse().unwrap_or(0.0))
                .collect();

            samples.push(Sample { depth, properties });
        }

        holes.push(Drillhole {
            id,
            start: (start_x, start_y, start_z),
            direction: (dir_x, dir_y, dir_z),
            length,
            samples,
        });
    }

    let mut suspects = if holes.len() < 500 {
        detect_outliers_small(&holes, &property_names)
    } else {
        detect_outliers_large(&holes, &property_names)
    };

    suspects.sort_by(|a, b| b.confidence.partial_cmp(&a.confidence).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));

    println!("{}", suspects.len());
    for suspect in suspects {
        println!(
            "{} {} {} {:.6}",
            suspect.hole_id, suspect.sample_idx, suspect.property_name, suspect.confidence
        );
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class TetrisPlayer
{
    private int[] columnHeights;
    private int width;
    private int boardHeight;
    private bool[,] fullBoard;

    static void Main()
    {
        var input = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        int width = int.Parse(input[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(input[1]);
        int numPieces = int.Parse(input[2]);

        var player = new TetrisPlayer(width, height);

        for (int i = 0; i < numPieces; i++)
        {
            char pieceType = Console.ReadLine().Trim()[0];
            (int rotation, int column) = player.FindBestMove(pieceType);
            Console.WriteLine($"{rotation} {column}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            string result = Console.ReadLine().Trim();
            if (result.StartsWith("cleared_"))
            {
                int clearedLines = int.Parse(result.Substring(8));
                player.ProcessClearedLines(clearedLines);
            }
            else if (result == "gameover")
            {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    public TetrisPlayer(int w, int h)
    {
        width = w;
        boardHeight = h;
        columnHeights = new int[width];
        fullBoard = new bool[boardHeight, width];
    }

    public (int rotation, int column) FindBestMove(char pieceType)
    {
        int bestRotation = 0;
        int bestColumn = 0;
        double bestScore = double.MinValue;

        for (int rotation = 0; rotation < 4; rotation++)
        {
            var (shape, w) = GetPieceShape(pieceType, rotation);

            for (int column = 0; column <= this.width - w; column++)
            {
                if (CanPlace(shape, column))
                {
                    double score = EvaluatePlacement(shape, column);
                    if (score > bestScore)
                    {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rotation;
                        bestColumn = column;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        PlacePiece(GetPieceShape(pieceType, bestRotation).shape, bestColumn);
        return (bestRotation, bestColumn);
    }

    private (int[], int) GetPieceShape(char type, int rotation)
    {
        rotation = rotation % 4;

        return type switch
        {
            'I' => rotation switch
            {
                0 or 2 => (new[] { 0, 1, 2, 3 }, 4),
                _ => (new[] { 0, 0, 0, 0 }, 1)
            },
            'O' => (new[] { 0, 1, 0, 1 }, 2),
            'T' => rotation switch
            {
                0 => (new[] { 0, -1, 0, 1 }, 3),
                1 => (new[] { -1, 0, 0, 1 }, 2),
                2 => (new[] { -1, 0, 1, 0 }, 3),
                _ => (new[] { -1, 0, 1, 0 }, 2)
            },
            'S' => rotation switch
            {
                0 or 2 => (new[] { 0, 1, -1, 0 }, 3),
                _ => (new[] { -1, 0, 0, 1 }, 2)
            },
            'Z' => rotation switch
            {
                0 or 2 => (new[] { -1, 0, 0, 1 }, 3),
                _ => (new[] { 0, -1, 1, 0 }, 2)
            },
            'J' => rotation switch
            {
                0 => (new[] { -1, 0, 1, -1 }, 3),
                1 => (new[] { -1, -1, 0, 1 }, 2),
                2 => (new[] { 0, 1, -1, 1 }, 3),
                _ => (new[] { -1, 0, 1, 1 }, 2)
            },
            'L' => rotation switch
            {
                0 => (new[] { -1, 0, 1, 1 }, 3),
                1 => (new[] { -1, 1, 0, 1 }, 2),
                2 => (new[] { -1, -1, 0, 1 }, 3),
                _ => (new[] { -1, -1, 0, 1 }, 2)
            },
            _ => (new[] { 0 }, 1)
        };
    }

    private bool CanPlace(int[] shape, int startColumn)
    {
        int minCol = int.MaxValue, maxCol = int.MinValue;
        for (int i = 0; i < shape.Length; i++)
        {
            int col = startColumn + shape[i];
            minCol = Math.Min(minCol, col);
            maxCol = Math.Max(maxCol, col);
        }

        return minCol >= 0 && maxCol < width;
    }

    private double EvaluatePlacement(int[] shape, int startColumn)
    {
        var tempHeights = (int[])columnHeights.Clone();

        int maxHeight = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < shape.Length; i++)
        {
            int col = startColumn + shape[i];
            int newHeight = tempHeights[col] + 1;
            tempHeights[col] = newHeight;
            maxHeight = Math.Max(maxHeight, newHeight);
        }

        double score = 0;
        score -= maxHeight * 50;

        int avgHeight = tempHeights.Sum() / width;
        int heightVariance = tempHeights.Sum(h => Math.Abs(h - avgHeight));
        score -= heightVariance * 2;

        int holes = 0;
        for (int col = 0; col < width; col++)
        {
            int filledCells = 0;
            int gapCells = 0;
            for (int row = 0; row < boardHeight; row++)
            {
                if (fullBoard[row, col])
                    filledCells++;
                else if (row > tempHeights[col])
                    gapCells++;
            }
            holes += gapCells;
        }
        score -= holes * 30;

        return score;
    }

    private void PlacePiece(int[] shape, int startColumn)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < shape.Length; i++)
        {
            int col = startColumn + shape[i];
            columnHeights[col]++;

            if (columnHeights[col] <= boardHeight)
                fullBoard[columnHeights[col] - 1, col] = true;
        }
    }

    private void ProcessClearedLines(int clearedCount)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < width; i++)
        {
            columnHeights[i] = Math.Max(0, columnHeights[i] - clearedCount);
        }

        for (int row = clearedCount; row < boardHeight; row++)
        {
            for (int col = 0; col < width; col++)
            {
                if (row - clearedCount >= 0)
                    fullBoard[row - clearedCount, col] = fullBoard[row, col];
                else
                    fullBoard[row - clearedCount, col] = false;
            }
        }

        for (int row = boardHeight - clearedCount; row < boardHeight; row++)
        {
            for (int col = 0; col < width; col++)
            {
                fullBoard[row, col] = false;
            }
        }
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Rust code to play Lunar Lander in real-time.

Your Rust lunar lander controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from simple
training environments to very complex landing sites.

Control a lunar lander to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a 2D voxel map and continuous state updates, and must output thrust/turn
commands to land safely on the target.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time. If your code
doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the io buffer fills up, the ship will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes that
async code doesn't have. Multithreaded / asyncio code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Physics:**
- Gravity pulls lander down constantly
- Thrust applies force in lander's facing direction
- Fuel is limited
- Must land softly on target (low velocity)

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal numbers):**
Initial map:
```
width height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y target_x target_y
map rows (. = empty, # = obstacle, S = start, T = target, L = landing zone)
```

Then you recieve continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds):
```
x y vx vy angle angular_vel fuel_remaining
```
x and y are in meters, from the worlds top left, and y increases downward.
vx and vy are in m/s.
angle is in radians, 0 is facing up.
angular_vel is in radians per second. + is clockwise, - is counterclockwise.
fuel_remaining is seconds at max_thrust.

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following instructions at a frequency of at least 20hz:
```
thrust turn
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max thrust)
- turn: -1.0 to 1.0 (turning rate, negative = left, positive = right)

To be crystal clear: that's two decimal numbers seperated by a space, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (so it misses 2 consecutive updates), the engine
will automatically cut power. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

Map size can vary from 100x50 to multi-gb maps, so be efficient with memory and processing.

Thrust and gravity are in m/s/s. 100% engine burn burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

Lander size is approximatly 1x1m, and the 2D map grid size is 1m x 1m.

Turn is in radians per second. The lander can not rotate fully around and will clamp rotation to
facing down if attempted.

Y increases downward. Positive vy means moving downward. Gravity is +g.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 2m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries
- Complete landing within time limit

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into obstacle or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed time limit

Typical Prompt:
You are writing C++ code to play a 3D Lunar Lander game in real-time.

Your C++ controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from tiny (100m) to huge (100km).
The same code must work for all scales.

Control a lunar lander in full 3D space to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a terrain file path and continuous state updates via stdin, and must
output thrust/rotation commands to stdout in real-time.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time.
If your code doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the IO buffer fills up, the ship
will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes
that async code doesn't have. Multithreaded code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Coordinate System:**
- X: horizontal (East), Y: horizontal (North), Z: UP.
- Gravity acts in the -Z direction.
- All positions are in meters. Velocities in m/s. Angles in radians.

**Physics:**
- Gravity = 1.62 m/s² (lunar) in -Z direction.
- Thrust is along the lander's local "up" axis. When pitch=0 and yaw=0, thrust is
straight up (+Z). Tilting via pitch/yaw redirects thrust.
- Pitch: tilts the lander. +pitch tilts forward, redirecting thrust partially into -X.
Pitch is clamped to [-pi/2, pi/2].
- Yaw: rotates heading around Z.
- Roll: rolls around the thrust axis (cosmetic only, does not affect thrust direction).
- Rotation dynamics: commands apply angular acceleration (2 rad/s² per unit).
Angular rates are damped by 0.95 per tick.
- Fuel: 100% thrust burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

**Input format (stdin):**
Initial header (whitespace separated decimal numbers, except terrain path):
```
width depth height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y start_z target_x target_y target_z
terrain_file_path
STATE
```

The terrain_file_path is on its own line (the path may contain spaces).
Read the entire line with getline() or equivalent.

**Terrain file format (binary):**
The terrain file defines the 3D world as a binary file. It is a sequence of
uint16_t triplets (little-endian), one per (x, y) cell, stored in row-major order:

```cpp
for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
for (int y = 0; y < depth; y++) {
uint16_t a = read_uint16_le(); // ground rock top
uint16_t b = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock bottom
uint16_t c = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock top
}
}

For each column (x, y), the vertical structure is:
- z < a: SOLID ROCK (ground)
- a <= z < b: OPEN AIR
- b <= z < c: SOLID ROCK (floating terrain feature, overhang, arch, etc.)
- c <= z: OPEN AIR

If b == c, there is no floating rock in that column (just ground + open sky).
The file size is exactly width * depth * 6 bytes.

You have a startup grace period to parse this file before state updates begin.
The grace period is 5 seconds plus 10 seconds per gigabyte of terrain file.
For a 100x100 map this is ~5s. For a 100000x10000 map (~6GB) this is ~65s.
You may continue parsing in a background thread after the simulation begins,
but you MUST be reading stdin and writing stdout by then to avoid a crash.

Then continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds, whitespace separated):
```
x y z vx vy vz pitch yaw roll pitch_rate yaw_rate roll_rate fuel_remaining
```

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following at a frequency of at least 10hz:
```
thrust pitch_cmd yaw_cmd roll_cmd
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max_thrust)
- pitch_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (pitch angular acceleration command)
- yaw_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (yaw angular acceleration command)
- roll_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (roll angular acceleration command)

To be crystal clear: four decimal numbers separated by spaces, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (misses 2 consecutive updates), the
engine will cut thrust automatically. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

**Landing:**
- The target is at (target_x, target_y, target_z) which is just above the terrain.
- You must land within a small radius of the target with total speed < 3 m/s.
- Landing zone radius is approximately max(5, min(width,depth)*0.02) meters.

**Terrain collisions:**
- You collide if you enter any solid cell as defined by the terrain file.
- Out of bounds (x<0, x>=width, y<0, y>=depth, z<0, z>=height) is also a collision.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 3 m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into terrain or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed simulation time limit

#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <thread>
#include <mutex>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <chrono>
#include <atomic>
#include <queue>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

struct State {
    double x, y, z;
    double vx, vy, vz;
    double pitch, yaw, roll;
    double pitch_rate, yaw_rate, roll_rate;
    double fuel;
};

struct Command {
    double thrust, pitch_cmd, yaw_cmd, roll_cmd;
};

struct TerrainCell {
    uint16_t ground_top, floating_bottom, floating_top;
};

int width, depth, height;
double gravity, max_thrust;
double target_x, target_y, target_z;
vector<vector<TerrainCell>> terrain;

mutex state_mutex;
State current_state;
bool state_updated = false;
condition_variable state_cv;

atomic<bool> running(true);
atomic<bool> terrain_loaded(false);

void read_terrain(const string& filepath) {
    ifstream file(filepath, ios::binary);
    if (!file) return;

    terrain.resize(width, vector<TerrainCell>(depth));

    for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
        for (int y = 0; y < depth; y++) {
            uint16_t a, b, c;
            file.read((char*)&a, 2);
            file.read((char*)&b, 2);
            file.read((char*)&c, 2);
            terrain[x][y] = {a, b, c};
        }
    }
    terrain_loaded = true;
}

bool check_collision(double x, double y, double z) {
    if (x < 0 || x >= width || y < 0 || y >= depth || z < 0 || z >= height) {
        return true;
    }

    int xi = (int)x;
    int yi = (int)y;
    if (xi >= width) xi = width - 1;
    if (yi >= depth) yi = depth - 1;

    auto& cell = terrain[xi][yi];

    if (z < cell.ground_top) return true;
    if (z >= cell.floating_bottom && z < cell.floating_top) return true;

    return false;
}

bool is_landed(const State& s) {
    double dist = sqrt((s.x - target_x) * (s.x - target_x) +
                       (s.y - target_y) * (s.y - target_y));
    double landing_radius = max(5.0, min(width, depth) * 0.02);
    double speed = sqrt(s.vx * s.vx + s.vy * s.vy + s.vz * s.vz);

    return dist < landing_radius && speed < 3.0 && s.z <= target_z + 1.0;
}

void input_thread_fn() {
    string line;
    while (running && getline(cin, line)) {
        if (line == "STATE") {
            break;
        }
    }

    while (running) {
        State s;
        if (!(cin >> s.x >> s.y >> s.z >> s.vx >> s.vy >> s.vz
                   >> s.pitch >> s.yaw >> s.roll
                   >> s.pitch_rate >> s.yaw_rate >> s.roll_rate >> s.fuel)) {
            running = false;
            state_cv.notify_all();
            break;
        }

        {
            lock_guard<mutex> lock(state_mutex);
            current_state = s;
            state_updated = true;
        }
        state_cv.notify_all();
    }
}

Command compute_control(const State& s) {
    Command cmd = {0, 0, 0, 0};

    if (!terrain_loaded || is_landed(s)) {
        return cmd;
    }

    // Distance to target
    double dx = target_x - s.x;
    double dy = target_y - s.y;
    double dz = target_z - s.z;
    double horiz_dist = sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);

    // Altitude control
    double descent_rate = 0.5;
    if (horiz_dist > 50) {
        descent_rate = 1.0;
    }

    double desired_vz = -descent_rate;
    double vz_error = s.vz - desired_vz;
    double thrust_needed = (gravity + vz_error * 0.3) / (gravity * 10.0);
    thrust_needed = max(0.0, min(1.0, thrust_needed));
    cmd.thrust = thrust_needed;

    // Lateral control
    if (horiz_dist > 2.0) {
        double target_angle = atan2(dy, dx);
        double yaw_error = target_angle - s.yaw;
        while (yaw_error > M_PI) yaw_error -= 2 * M_PI;
        while (yaw_error < -M_PI) yaw_error += 2 * M_PI;
        cmd.yaw_cmd = max(-1.0, min(1.0, yaw_error * 0.5));

        double pitch_cmd = max(-1.0, min(1.0, horiz_dist * 0.05));
        cmd.pitch_cmd = pitch_cmd * cos(yaw_error);
    } else {
        cmd.pitch_cmd = max(-1.0, min(1.0, s.vx * 0.5));
        cmd.yaw_cmd = max(-1.0, min(1.0, s.vy * 0.5));
    }

    // Damping for landing
    if (horiz_dist < 20) {
        cmd.thrust *= (1.0 - 0.03 * (20 - horiz_dist));
        cmd.pitch_cmd *= 0.7;
        cmd.yaw_cmd *= 0.7;
    }

    return cmd;
}

void control_loop() {
    auto last_output = chrono::steady_clock::now();

    while (running) {
        {
            unique_lock<mutex> lock(state_mutex);
            state_cv.wait_for(lock, chrono::milliseconds(150), [] { return state_updated; });
            state_updated = false;
        }

        if (!running) break;

        State s;
        {
            lock_guard<mutex> lock(state_mutex);
            s = current_state;
        }

        Command cmd = compute_control(s);

        cout << fixed << setprecision(6)
             << cmd.thrust << " "
             << cmd.pitch_cmd << " "
             << cmd.yaw_cmd << " "
             << cmd.roll_cmd << "\n";
        cout.flush();

        auto now = chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto elapsed = chrono::duration_cast<chrono::milliseconds>(now - last_output).count();
        if (elapsed < 100) {
            this_thread::sleep_for(chrono::milliseconds(100 - elapsed));
        }
        last_output = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    double start_x, start_y, start_z;
    string terrain_path;

    cin >> width >> depth >> height >> gravity >> max_thrust;
    double fuel;
    cin >> fuel;
    cin >> start_x >> start_y >> start_z;
    cin >> target_x >> target_y >> target_z;
    cin.ignore();
    getline(cin, terrain_path);

    current_state = {start_x, start_y, start_z, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, fuel};

    // Load terrain in background
    thread terrain_thread(read_terrain, terrain_path);

    // Start input and control threads
    thread input_thread(input_thread_fn);
    thread control_thread(control_loop);

    // Wait for threads
    input_thread.join();
    control_thread.join();
    terrain_thread.join();

    return 0;
}

You are writing C# code to calculate an asteroid interception trajectory.

advanced trajectory optimization with multi-flyby maneuvers and gravitational assist sequences required.

**Problem:**
Calculate a spacecraft trajectory to intercept and deflect an asteroid on collision course
with Earth using kinetic impact.

**The solver must output:**
1. Launch window and initial trajectory
2. Mid-course correction burn(s)
3. Final approach for kinetic impact

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal/scientific notation numbers):**
```
num_bodies warning_days impactor_mass delta_v_budget asteroid_mass t0_unix_utc
body_name mass x y z vx vy vz (for each body)
de421.bsp_file_path

All values are in SI units unless otherwise specified. Eg mass of earth is 5.972e24 kg.
All positions + velocities are relative to solar system barycenter.

- **t0_unix_utc** is the UTC time of the provided initial state (t=0).

The simulation uses the JPL DE421 model of the solar system with Sun, Earth, Moon, and major planets,
and a KDK integrator to calculate trajectories. The path to the DE421 model is provided in the input
so your code can precisely match the simulation at extreme precision.

- Total delta-v usage stays within budget

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Globalization;

class AsteroidInterception
{
    const double G = 6.67430e-11;
    const double AU = 1.496e11;
    const double DAY = 86400;

    struct Vector3
    {
        public double X, Y, Z;
        public Vector3(double x, double y, double z) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }
        public static Vector3 operator +(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z);
        public static Vector3 operator -(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z);
        public static Vector3 operator *(Vector3 v, double s) => new Vector3(v.X * s, v.Y * s, v.Z * s);
        public static Vector3 operator *(double s, Vector3 v) => v * s;
        public double Dot(Vector3 other) => X * other.X + Y * other.Y + Z * other.Z;
        public Vector3 Cross(Vector3 other) => new Vector3(Y * other.Z - Z * other.Y, Z * other.X - X * other.Z, X * other.Y - Y * other.X);
        public double Length => Math.Sqrt(X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z);
        public Vector3 Normalize() { double len = Length; return len > 0 ? this * (1.0 / len) : this; }
    }

    struct Body
    {
        public string Name;
        public double Mass;
        public Vector3 Position;
        public Vector3 Velocity;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        var input = Console.In.ReadToEnd().Split(new[] { '\n', '\r' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        int idx = 0;

        var parts = input[idx++].Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        int numBodies = int.Parse(parts[0]);
        double warningDays = double.Parse(parts[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        double impactorMass = double.Parse(parts[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        double deltaVBudget = double.Parse(parts[3], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        double asteroidMass = double.Parse(parts[4], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        long t0Unix = long.Parse(parts[5]);

        var bodies = new List<Body>();
        Body? earth = null, asteroid = null;

        for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; i++)
        {
            parts = input[idx++].Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            string name = parts[0];
            double mass = double.Parse(parts[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            var pos = new Vector3(
                double.Parse(parts[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                double.Parse(parts[3], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                double.Parse(parts[4], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            var vel = new Vector3(
                double.Parse(parts[5], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                double.Parse(parts[6], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                double.Parse(parts[7], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

            var body = new Body { Name = name, Mass = mass, Position = pos, Velocity = vel };
            bodies.Add(body);

            if (name == "Earth") earth = body;
            if (name == "Asteroid") asteroid = body;
        }

        string de421Path = input[idx++].Trim();

        var burns = SolveInterception(bodies, earth.Value, asteroid.Value, warningDays, deltaVBudget, asteroidMass);

        Console.WriteLine(burns.Count);
        foreach (var burn in burns)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{burn.Time:F6} {burn.DeltaV.X:E15} {burn.DeltaV.Y:E15} {burn.DeltaV.Z:E15}");
        }
    }

    struct Burn
    {
        public double Time;
        public Vector3 DeltaV;
    }

    static List<Burn> SolveInterception(List<Body> bodies, Body earth, Body asteroid, double warningDays, double deltaVBudget, double asteroidMass)
    {
        var burns = new List<Burn>();

        double sunMass = bodies.First(b => b.Name == "Sun").Mass;

        Vector3 earthPos = earth.Position;
        Vector3 asteroidPos = asteroid.Position;
        Vector3 asteroidVel = asteroid.Velocity;

        double impactTime = EstimateImpactTime(earthPos, asteroidPos, asteroidVel, warningDays * DAY);

        if (impactTime < 0 || impactTime > warningDays * DAY)
        {
            impactTime = warningDays * 0.5 * DAY;
        }

        Vector3 earthVel = earth.Velocity;
        double launchTime = 10 * DAY;

        Vector3 interceptPos = asteroidPos + asteroidVel * (impactTime - 0);

        Vector3 launchDeltaV = CalculateLaunchDeltaV(earthPos, earthVel, interceptPos, launchTime, sunMass);

        double launchDVMag = launchDeltaV.Length;
        if (launchDVMag > 0.1)
        {
            burns.Add(new Burn { Time = launchTime / DAY, DeltaV = launchDeltaV });
        }

        double remainingDeltaV = deltaVBudget - launchDVMag;
        if (remainingDeltaV > 100 && impactTime - launchTime > 30 * DAY)
        {
            double correctionTime = launchTime + (impactTime - launchTime) * 0.5;
            Vector3 correctionDeltaV = CalculateCorrectionDeltaV(remainingDeltaV * 0.3);
            burns.Add(new Burn { Time = correctionTime / DAY, DeltaV = correctionDeltaV });
            remainingDeltaV -= correctionDeltaV.Length;
        }

        Vector3 finalDeltaV = CalculateFinalDeltaV(remainingDeltaV * 0.7);
        burns.Add(new Burn { Time = impactTime / DAY, DeltaV = finalDeltaV });

        return burns;
    }

    static double EstimateImpactTime(Vector3 earthPos, Vector3 asteroidPos, Vector3 asteroidVel, double maxTime)
    {
        Vector3 relPos = asteroidPos - earthPos;
        Vector3 relVel = asteroidVel;

        double a = relVel.Dot(relVel);
        double b = 2 * relPos.Dot(relVel);
        double c = relPos.Dot(relPos);

        if (a < 1e-10) return maxTime * 0.5;

        double discriminant = b * b - 4 * a * c;
        if (discriminant < 0) return maxTime * 0.5;

        double t1 = (-b - Math.Sqrt(discriminant)) / (2 * a);
        double t2 = (-b + Math.Sqrt(discriminant)) / (2 * a);

        double t = (t1 > 0) ? t1 : t2;
        return Math.Max(0, Math.Min(t, maxTime));
    }

    static Vector3 CalculateLaunchDeltaV(Vector3 earthPos, Vector3 earthVel, Vector3 targetPos, double launchTime, double sunMass)
    {
        Vector3 relativePos = targetPos - earthPos;
        double distance = relativePos.Length;

        if (distance < 1e6) return new Vector3(0, 0, 0);

        Vector3 direction = relativePos.Normalize();

        double travelTime = launchTime;
        double neededSpeed = distance / (travelTime + 1);
        Vector3 currentVelocity = earthVel;
        Vector3 targetVelocity = direction * neededSpeed;

        Vector3 deltaV = targetVelocity - currentVelocity;

        double mag = deltaV.Length;
        if (mag > 20000) deltaV = deltaV * (20000 / mag);

        return deltaV;
    }

    static Vector3 CalculateCorrectionDeltaV(double budget)
    {
        return new Vector3(Math.Sqrt(budget) * 0.1, Math.Sqrt(budget) * 0.05, 0);
    }

    static Vector3 CalculateFinalDeltaV(double budget)
    {
        double mag = Math.Sqrt(budget * budget);
        return new Vector3(mag * 0.6, mag * 0.8, 0);
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Rust code to cluster 3D points into exactly N clusters.

You must write a Rust solver that can handle ANY clustering scenario from trivial to ludicrous scale:
- **Trivial**: Small datasets (1M points, 10 clusters), basic k-means, memory-friendly
- **Medium**: Moderate datasets (10M points, 100 clusters), optimized k-means, streaming
- **Large**: Large datasets (100M points, 1000 clusters), mini-batch k-means, memory constraints
- **Extreme**: Massive datasets (1B-10B points, 10000 clusters), streaming algorithms, very tight memory

**The Challenge:**
Your Rust clustering algorithm will be tested with datasets ranging from millions to billions of 3D points. The same algorithm must work efficiently across ALL scales while respecting memory constraints.

**Problem:**
Given millions to billions of 3D points, partition them into exactly N clusters minimizing within-cluster variance (k-means objective). Points are provided as binary float32 triples for efficiency.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
num_points num_clusters
[x y z] (as binary float32 triples, num_points total)
```

**Output format (stdout):**
```
[cluster_index] (as binary uint32, one per point)
```

**Critical Requirements:**
1. **Scalability**: Your algorithm must adapt based on point count and cluster count
2. **Performance**: Must complete within 5 minutes even for massive datasets
3. **Memory**: Must handle streaming input for datasets that don't fit in memory
4. **Quality**: Minimize within-cluster variance while producing exactly N clusters

**Algorithm Strategy Recommendations:**
- **Small datasets (≤10M points)**: Can use standard k-means with full data in memory
- **Medium datasets (10M-100M points)**: Mini-batch k-means, streaming updates
- **Large datasets (100M-1B points)**: Streaming k-means with limited memory buffers
- **Very Large datasets (>1B points)**: Very fast streaming, approximate clustering

**Key Techniques:**
- **Streaming algorithms**: Process points in batches without storing all data
- **Mini-batch k-means**: Update centroids incrementally
- **Memory management**: Use fixed-size buffers for large datasets
- **Binary I/O**: Efficient reading/writing of binary data
- **Convergence detection**: Monitor when clustering stabilizes

**Implementation Hints:**
- Detect dataset size and choose appropriate clustering algorithm
- Use efficient binary I/O (std::io::BufReader/BufWriter)
- Implement streaming updates for large datasets
- For very large datasets, use approximation algorithms
- Handle edge cases: empty clusters, convergence issues
- Use fast random access for centroid updates

**Binary Format Details:**
- Input: Points as little-endian f32 triples (12 bytes per point)
- Output: Cluster indices as little-endian u32 (4 bytes per point)
- Total input size: num_points × 12 bytes
- Total output size: num_points × 4 bytes

**Memory Constraints:**
- Small datasets: Can load all points into memory
- Medium datasets: Use streaming with moderate buffers
- Large datasets: Streaming with minimal memory footprint
- Very Large datasets: Extremely memory-efficient streaming

**Requirements:**
1. Program must compile with rustc (edition 2021)
2. Read binary input from stdin, write binary output to stdout
3. Handle variable point counts and cluster numbers
4. Complete within 5 minutes
5. Must handle varying dataset sizes efficiently
6. Produce exactly N clusters

Write complete, compilable Rust code with a main function.
Include adaptive logic that chooses different strategies based on clustering complexity.

use std::io::{self, Read, Write};
use std::f32;

const MAX_ITERATIONS: usize = 100;
const CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD: f32 = 1e-4;
const STREAMING_BATCH_SIZE: usize = 100_000;
const MINI_BATCH_SIZE: usize = 10_000;

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Point {
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
    z: f32,
}

impl Point {
    fn distance_squared(&self, other: &Point) -> f32 {
        let dx = self.x - other.x;
        let dy = self.y - other.y;
        let dz = self.z - other.z;
        dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
    }
}

fn read_binary_f32(reader: &mut io::BufReader<io::Stdin>, count: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<f32>> {
    let mut buffer = vec![0u8; count * 4];
    reader.read_exact(&mut buffer)?;

    let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(count);
    for i in 0..count {
        let bytes = [buffer[i*4], buffer[i*4+1], buffer[i*4+2], buffer[i*4+3]];
        values.push(f32::from_le_bytes(bytes));
    }
    Ok(values)
}

fn write_binary_u32(values: &[u32]) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut stdout = io::stdout().lock();
    for &val in values {
        stdout.write_all(&val.to_le_bytes())?;
    }
    stdout.flush()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn initialize_centroids(points: &[Point], k: usize) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut centroids = Vec::with_capacity(k);
    let n = points.len();

    if n < k {
        for i in 0..n {
            centroids.push(points[i].clone());
        }
        for _ in n..k {
            centroids.push(Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 });
        }
    } else {
        let step = n / k;
        for i in 0..k {
            centroids.push(points[i * step].clone());
        }
    }
    centroids
}

fn assign_clusters(points: &[Point], centroids: &[Point]) -> Vec<u32> {
    points
        .iter()
        .map(|p| {
            let mut best_cluster = 0u32;
            let mut best_dist = f32::INFINITY;

            for (i, c) in centroids.iter().enumerate() {
                let dist = p.distance_squared(c);
                if dist < best_dist {
                    best_dist = dist;
                    best_cluster = i as u32;
                }
            }
            best_cluster
        })
        .collect()
}

fn update_centroids(points: &[Point], assignments: &[u32], k: usize) -> (Vec<Point>, f32) {
    let mut new_centroids = vec![Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }; k];
    let mut counts = vec![0u32; k];

    for (p, &cluster) in points.iter().zip(assignments.iter()) {
        let c = cluster as usize;
        if c < k {
            new_centroids[c].x += p.x;
            new_centroids[c].y += p.y;
            new_centroids[c].z += p.z;
            counts[c] += 1;
        }
    }

    let mut movement = 0.0f32;
    for i in 0..k {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let count = counts[i] as f32;
            new_centroids[i].x /= count;
            new_centroids[i].y /= count;
            new_centroids[i].z /= count;
        } else {
            new_centroids[i] = Point { x: f32::NAN, y: f32::NAN, z: f32::NAN };
        }
    }

    (new_centroids, movement)
}

fn kmeans_full(points: Vec<Point>, k: usize) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut centroids = initialize_centroids(&points, k);

    for _iter in 0..MAX_ITERATIONS {
        let assignments = assign_clusters(&points, &centroids);
        let (new_centroids, _movement) = update_centroids(&points, &assignments, k);
        centroids = new_centroids;
    }

    assign_clusters(&points, &centroids)
}

fn kmeans_mini_batch(reader: &mut io::BufReader<io::Stdin>, num_points: usize, k: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<u32>> {
    let mut centroids = vec![Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }; k];
    let mut centroid_counts = vec![0u32; k];
    let mut assignments = Vec::with_capacity(num_points);

    let mut points_read = 0;
    while points_read < num_points {
        let batch_size = std::cmp::min(MINI_BATCH_SIZE, num_points - points_read);
        let coords = read_binary_f32(reader, batch_size * 3)?;

        let mut batch_points = Vec::with_capacity(batch_size);
        for i in 0..batch_size {
            batch_points.push(Point {
                x: coords[i * 3],
                y: coords[i * 3 + 1],
                z: coords[i * 3 + 2],
            });
        }

        let batch_assignments = assign_clusters(&batch_points, &centroids);

        for (p, &cluster) in batch_points.iter().zip(batch_assignments.iter()) {
            let c = cluster as usize;
            if c < k {
                centroids[c].x += p.x;
                centroids[c].y += p.y;
                centroids[c].z += p.z;
                centroid_counts[c] += 1;
            }
            assignments.push(cluster);
        }

        for i in 0..k {
            if centroid_counts[i] > 0 {
                let count = centroid_counts[i] as f32;
                centroids[i].x /= count;
                centroids[i].y /= count;
                centroids[i].z /= count;
            }
        }

        points_read += batch_size;
    }

    Ok(assignments)
}

fn kmeans_streaming(reader: &mut io::BufReader<io::Stdin>, num_points: usize, k: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<u32>> {
    let mut centroids = vec![Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }; k];
    let mut centroid_counts = vec![0u32; k];
    let mut assignments = Vec::with_capacity(num_points);

    let mut points_read = 0;
    while points_read < num_points {
        let batch_size = std::cmp::min(STREAMING_BATCH_SIZE, num_points - points_read);
        let coords = read_binary_f32(reader, batch_size * 3)?;

        let mut batch_points = Vec::with_capacity(batch_size);
        for i in 0..batch_size {
            batch_points.push(Point {
                x: coords[i * 3],
                y: coords[i * 3 + 1],
                z: coords[i * 3 + 2],
            });
        }

        let batch_assignments = assign_clusters(&batch_points, &centroids);

        for (p, &cluster) in batch_points.iter().zip(batch_assignments.iter()) {
            let c = cluster as usize;
            if c < k {
                let alpha = 1.0 / (centroid_counts[c] as f32 + 1.0);
                centroids[c].x = centroids[c].x * (1.0 - alpha) + p.x * alpha;
                centroids[c].y = centroids[c].y * (1.0 - alpha) + p.y * alpha;
                centroids[c].z = centroids[c].z * (1.0 - alpha) + p.z * alpha;
                centroid_counts[c] += 1;
            }
            assignments.push(cluster);
        }

        points_read += batch_size;
    }

    Ok(assignments)
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut reader = io::BufReader::with_capacity(1024 * 1024, stdin.lock());

    let mut header = String::new();
    let mut temp_reader = io::BufReader::new(io::stdin());
    temp_reader.read_line(&mut header)?;
    drop(temp_reader);

    let parts: Vec<&str> = header.trim().split_whitespace().collect();
    let num_points: usize = parts[0].parse().expect("Invalid num_points");
    let k: usize = parts[1].parse().expect("Invalid k");

    let assignments = if num_points <= 10_000_000 {
        let coords = read_binary_f32(&mut reader, num_points * 3)?;
        let mut points = Vec::with_capacity(num_points);
        for i in 0..num_points {
            points.push(Point {
                x: coords[i * 3],
                y: coords[i * 3 + 1],
                z: coords[i * 3 + 2],
            });
        }
        kmeans_full(points, k)
    } else if num_points <= 100_000_000 {
        kmeans_mini_batch(&mut reader, num_points, k)?
    } else {
        kmeans_streaming(&mut reader, num_points, k)?
    };

    write_binary_u32(&assignments)?;
    Ok(())
}

            new_centroids[c].x += p.x;
            new_centroids[c].y += p.y;
            new_centroids[c].z += p.z;
            counts[c] += 1;
        }
    }

    let mut movement = 0.0f32;
    for i in 0..k {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let count = counts[i] as f32;
            new_centroids[i].x /= count;
            new_centroids[i].y /= count;
            new_centroids[i].z /= count;
        } else {
            new_centroids[i] = Point { x: f32::NAN, y: f32::NAN, z: f32::NAN };
        }
    }

    (new_centroids, movement)
}

fn kmeans_full(points: Vec<Point>, k: usize) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut centroids = initialize_centroids(&points, k);

    for _iter in 0..MAX_ITERATIONS {
        let assignments = assign_clusters(&points, &centroids);
        let (new_centroids, _movement) = update_centroids(&points, &assignments, k);
        centroids = new_centroids;
    }

    assign_clusters(&points, &centroids)
}

fn kmeans_mini_batch(reader: &mut io::BufReader<io::Stdin>, num_points: usize, k: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<u32>> {
    let mut centroids = vec![Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }; k];
    let mut centroid_counts = vec![0u32; k];
    let mut assignments = Vec::with_capacity(num_points);

    let mut points_read = 0;
    while points_read < num_points {
        let batch_size = std::cmp::min(MINI_BATCH_SIZE, num_points - points_read);
        let coords = read_binary_f32(reader, batch_size * 3)?;

        let mut batch_points = Vec::with_capacity(batch_size);
        for i in 0..batch_size {
            batch_points.push(Point {
                x: coords[i * 3],
                y: coords[i * 3 + 1],
                z: coords[i * 3 + 2],
            });
        }

        let batch_assignments = assign_clusters(&batch_points, &centroids);

        for (p, &cluster) in batch_points.iter().zip(batch_assignments.iter()) {
            let c = cluster as usize;
            if c < k {
                centroids[c].x += p.x;
                centroids[c].y += p.y;
                centroids[c].z += p.z;
                centroid_counts[c] += 1;
            }
            assignments.push(cluster);
        }

        for i in 0..k {
            if centroid_counts[i] > 0 {
                let count = centroid_counts[i] as f32;
                centroids[i].x /= count;
                centroids[i].y /= count;
                centroids[i].z /= count;
            }
        }

        points_read += batch_size;
    }

    Ok(assignments)
}

fn kmeans_streaming(reader: &mut io::BufReader<io::Stdin>, num_points: usize, k: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<u32>> {
    let mut centroids = vec![Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }; k];
    let mut centroid_counts = vec![0u32; k];
    let mut assignments = Vec::with_capacity(num_points);

    let mut points_read = 0;
    while points_read < num_points {
        let batch_size = std::cmp::min(STREAMING_BATCH_SIZE, num_points - points_read);
        let coords = read_binary_f32(reader, batch_size * 3)?;

        let mut batch_points = Vec::with_capacity(batch_size);
        for i in 0..batch_size {
            batch_points.push(Point {
                x: coords[i * 3],
                y: coords[i * 3 + 1],
                z: coords[i * 3 + 2],
            });
        }

        let batch_assignments = assign_clusters(&batch_points, &centroids);

        for (p, &cluster) in batch_points.iter().zip(batch_assignments.iter()) {
            let c = cluster as usize;
            if c < k {
                let alpha = 1.0 / (centroid_counts[c] as f32 + 1.0);
                centroids[c].x = centroids[c].x * (1.0 - alpha) + p.x * alpha;
                centroids[c].y = centroids[c].y * (1.0 - alpha) + p.y * alpha;
                centroids[c].z = centroids[c].z * (1.0 - alpha) + p.z * alpha;
                centroid_counts[c] += 1;
            }
            assignments.push(cluster);
        }

        points_read += batch_size;
    }

    Ok(assignments)
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut reader = io::BufReader::with_capacity(1024 * 1024, stdin.lock());

    let mut header = String::new();
    let mut temp_reader = io::BufReader::new(io::stdin());
    temp_reader.read_line(&mut header)?;
    drop(temp_reader);

    let parts: Vec<&str> = header.trim().split_whitespace().collect();
    let num_points: usize = parts[0].parse().expect("Invalid num_points");
    let k: usize = parts[1].parse().expect("Invalid k");

    let assignments = if num_points <= 10_000_000 {
        let coords = read_binary_f32(&mut reader, num_points * 3)?;
        let mut points = Vec::with_capacity(num_points);
        for i in 0..num_points {
            points.push(Point {
                x: coords[i * 3],
                y: coords[i * 3 + 1],
                z: coords[i * 3 + 2],
            });
        }
        kmeans_full(points, k)
    } else if num_points <= 100_000_000 {
        kmeans_mini_batch(&mut reader, num_points, k)?
    } else {
        kmeans_streaming(&mut reader, num_points, k)?
    };

    write_binary_u32(&assignments)?;
    Ok(())
}

Finding the minimum number of colours is NP-hard. Subpasses increase the graph size and connectivity. The AI’s colouring must be valid (no clashes) and use as few colours as possible.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <unordered_set>

using namespace std;

class GraphColorer {
private:
    int num_vertices;
    int num_edges;
    int num_colors;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<int> color;
    vector<int> degree;

public:
    GraphColorer(int v, int e, int k)
        : num_vertices(v), num_edges(e), num_colors(k) {
        adj.resize(v);
        color.assign(v, -1);
        degree.assign(v, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v) {
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
        degree[u]++;
        degree[v]++;
    }

    // Welsh-Powell algorithm: greedy coloring with degree ordering
    bool colorWelshPowell() {
        vector<pair<int, int>> degreeOrder;
        for (int i = 0; i < num_vertices; i++) {
            degreeOrder.push_back({degree[i], i});
        }
        sort(degreeOrder.rbegin(), degreeOrder.rend());

        for (auto [deg, v] : degreeOrder) {
            unordered_set<int> usedColors;
            for (int u : adj[v]) {
                if (color[u] != -1) {
                    usedColors.insert(color[u]);
                }
            }

            int c = 0;
            while (usedColors.count(c)) c++;

            if (c >= num_colors) return false;
            color[v] = c;
        }
        return true;
    }

    // DSATUR algorithm: dynamic saturation degree ordering
    bool colorDSATUR() {
        vector<int> saturationDegree(num_vertices, 0);
        vector<bool> colored(num_vertices, false);

        for (int step = 0; step < num_vertices; step++) {
            int maxSat = -1, maxDeg = -1, v = -1;

            // Find uncolored vertex with highest saturation degree
            for (int i = 0; i < num_vertices; i++) {
                if (!colored[i]) {
                    if (saturationDegree[i] > maxSat ||
                        (saturationDegree[i] == maxSat && degree[i] > maxDeg)) {
                        maxSat = saturationDegree[i];
                        maxDeg = degree[i];
                        v = i;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (v == -1) break;

            // Find minimum available color
            unordered_set<int> usedColors;
            for (int u : adj[v]) {
                if (color[u] != -1) {
                    usedColors.insert(color[u]);
                }
            }

            int c = 0;
            while (usedColors.count(c)) c++;

            if (c >= num_colors) return false;

            color[v] = c;
            colored[v] = true;

            // Update saturation degrees of neighbors
            for (int u : adj[v]) {
                if (!colored[u]) {
                    saturationDegree[u]++;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    // Simple greedy coloring for very large graphs
    bool colorGreedy() {
        for (int v = 0; v < num_vertices; v++) {
            unordered_set<int> usedColors;
            for (int u : adj[v]) {
                if (color[u] != -1) {
                    usedColors.insert(color[u]);
                }
            }

            int c = 0;
            while (usedColors.count(c)) c++;

            if (c >= num_colors) return false;
            color[v] = c;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool solve() {
        // Choose strategy based on graph complexity
        if (num_vertices <= 1000) {
            // Small graphs: use DSATUR
            return colorDSATUR();
        } else if (num_vertices <= 10000) {
            // Medium graphs: use Welsh-Powell
            return colorWelshPowell();
        } else {
            // Large graphs: use greedy
            return colorGreedy();
        }
    }

    void printColors() {
        for (int i = 0; i < num_vertices; i++) {
            if (i > 0) cout << " ";
            cout << color[i];
        }
        cout << "\n";
    }

    bool isValid() {
        for (int v = 0; v < num_vertices; v++) {
            if (color[v] < 0 || color[v] >= num_colors) {
                return false;
            }
            for (int u : adj[v]) {
                if (color[v] == color[u]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int num_vertices, num_edges, num_colors;
    cin >> num_vertices >> num_edges >> num_colors;

    GraphColorer colorer(num_vertices, num_edges, num_colors);

    for (int i = 0; i < num_edges; i++) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        colorer.addEdge(u, v);
    }

    if (colorer.solve() && colorer.isValid()) {
        colorer.printColors();
    } else {
        // Fallback: output default coloring
        for (int i = 0; i < num_vertices; i++) {
            if (i > 0) cout << " ";
            cout << (i % num_colors);
        }
        cout << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
